outcomes.question: I returned to my country of residence without my checked bag. Am I automatically eligible for first needs allowance?
outcomes.final_response:
No. First Needs Allowance is not automatically granted when you arrive in your own country of residence without your checked bag.  

- The allowance is only payable to passengers who **arrive in a destination other than their domicile country of residence** — residents are excluded unless they can show proof of residence in another country for the previous six months [S1].  
- It is also subject to the bag being **still missing after 24 hours** from the arrival airport where the missing‑bag report was filed [S1].  
- Additional requirements include: no other bag has been received, proof of purchase receipts for essential items, and the applicable monetary limits (USD 150 for First/Premier World, USD 100 for Economy, with reduced limits for children) [S1].

Therefore, because you returned to your country of residence, you would only be eligible for First Needs Allowance if you can prove you have been residing in a different country for the last six months and the other conditions above are met. If those criteria are not met, the allowance does not apply.

outcomes.question: Je, katika safari yangu ijayo kuna nafasi ngapi zilizobaki katika daraja la biashara?
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, hatuna data ya idadi halisi ya viti vilivyobaki katika daraja la Biashara kwa safari yako inayofuata. Mfumo wa **Upgrade to Business Class** huonyesha tu upatikanaji wa viti vilivyobaki wakati wa kufanya ofa ya ubora, lakini taarifa ya nambari ya viti haiwezi kupatikana kupitia sera zilizotolewa — “assessed and the remaining Business Class seats available will be assigned” [S1].

Ili kujua idadi iliyobaki, tembelea kiungo cha **Upgrade Flight** au wasiliana moja kwa moja na Kituo cha Huduma kwa Wateja [S2]. Hii itakuwezesha kuona nafasi inapatikana kwa safari yako maalum.

outcomes.question: Niko chini ya legal age of majority kwa country yangu. Can I submit a Business upgrade bid myself?
outcomes.final_response:
Hapana, kwa sheria ya Kenya Airways, **unalazimika kufika umri wa ukomavu wa nchi yako ili kuwasilisha bid ya upgrade** – “For you to submit an Offer, you must have reached the legal age of majority in your country of residence at the time the Offer is submitted” [S1].

Kama bado uko chini ya umri huo, huwezi kufanya bid mwenyewe; itabidi mtu aliyekuwa na umri wa ukomavu (mfano mzazi au mlezi) atume bid kwa jina lako. 

Kumbuka pia unahitaji tiketi halali ya Economy na maelezo sahihi ya kadi ya mkopo ili kukamilisha bid, lakini hatua ya kwanza ni kuwa na umri wa ukomavu [S1].

outcomes.question: Nilibadilisha booking yangu through call centre jana. Can I edit hiyo same booking online now?
outcomes.final_response:
Hapo, baada ya ubadisi ulifanywa kwa simu (offline), **hutaweza kutengeneza / kubadilisha ule ule booking kupitia “Manage My Booking” online**. Vilevile, sera ya Kenya Airways inasema: “once changes have been made to a booking offline they cannot be modified online” [S1].  

Kwa hiyo, ikiwa unahitaji marekebisho zaidi, itakubidi uwasiliane tena na **Call Centre** au ofisi ya Kenya Airways.  

---  

*Ukihitaji kujua chaguo zingine za kubadilisha (kama tarehe, viti, n.k.)* – “Manage My Booking” inawezesha hayo, lakini si kwa booking ambayo tayari imebadilishwa offline.  

Tafadhali piga simu ili kupata msaada zaidi.

outcomes.question: Nikishathibitisha safari mpya, nitapokea nini kwa barua pepe?

fixed_history.content: KQ imebadilisha ratiba yangu na nimechagua ndege nyingine kupitia huduma ya kujipangia safari.
Ni taarifa gani ungependa kupata?

outcomes.final_response:
Baada ya kukamilisha uthibitisho wa safari mpya, mfumo utakutumia **barua pepe** iliyo na:

- **Maelezo ya safari iliyobadilishwa** (nambari ya ndege, tarehe, muda, kiwanja, n.k.) – hii inakuja mara moja baada ya mfumo kukufanyia re‑booking otomatiki au baada ya wewe kuchagua na kuthibitisha usafiri mwingine [S1].
- **Uthibitisho wa barua pepe** wa uamuzi wako, ambao unaunganisha kiungo cha kukubali mabadiliko (Accept Changes) [S1].
- **E‑ticket** yako ya safari hiyo mpya [S1].
- **Bango la kuabiri (boarding pass)** ikiwa inapatikana kisha (kwa huduma ya kidijitali) [S1].

Kwa hivyo, unatarajia kupokea barua pepe yenye taarifa kamili za safari na nyaraka za kusafiri.

outcomes.question: Niko na device, will they allow it onboard?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa kawaida, vifaa vya kielektroniki (kompyuta, simu, tablet, nk.) haziruhusiwi kuwekwa kwenye **Checked Baggage**; lazima viwe katika **cabin** yako. [S1]

Kama kifaa chako ni mojawapo ya **MacBook Pro 15‑inch** ya kizazi cha kale (iliyotolewa Sep 2015–Feb 2017) ambayo ilikuwa kwenye ukumbusho wa EASA, basi lazima **uchome** kifaa hicho, usikifanye kazi, usichaji, na umjulishe wakunga wa ndege mara tu kinaonekana kuwa na hitilafu, moto, au moshi. [S1]

Kwa kifaa kisicho kwenye orodha ya ukumbusho, hakuna vikwazo maalum; unaweza kuviweka katika kabati la kusimama, lakini hakikisha umefunga vigezo vya usalama (hakuna batri za litini zinazochoma, etc.). 

Kumbuka pia: vifaa vyote vilivyopitwa na muda wa matumizi au vilivyoharibika vinapaswa kutolewa mara moja kwa wakunga. [S1]

outcomes.question: Family yetu tuko same flight. Tunaweza pool baggage weight ili bag moja izidi limit yake?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, familia yako inaweza **pool** (kuunganisha) idadi ya mizigo ya bure mradi nyote mnakwenda pamoja kwenye safari moja na mnachek‑in kwenye mlango huo huo [S1]. Hii inamaanisha unaweza kutumia jumla ya vibebe vilivyotengwa kwa kila mtu kama “group allowance”.

Lakini **huna** haki ya kutumia uzito wa kifaa kimoja kupita kipimo kilichoruhusiwa kwa msafiri mmoja. Kila begi lazima liwe ndani ya uzito unaoruhusiwa kwa kifaa kimoja; uzito wa kifaa hauwezi kupitiliza kipimo cha bure cha uzito (kwa mfano, kama idadi ya bure ni 2 pc × 23 kg, begi moja haliwezi kuwa 26 kg). Kama kifaa kinavuka uzito wa bure, utatozwa ada ya ziada [S1].

Kwa kifupi:  

- **Unaweza** kuunganisha idadi ya mizigo ya familia (pooling).  
- **Haitaruhusiwi** kuunganisha uzito, kila begi lazima liwe ndani ya uzito wa bure unaoruhusiwa; vinginevyo, ada ya ziada itatozwa.  

Hakikisha mnachek‑in pamoja, kwenye ndege na mlango mmoja, na kila begi linapewa lebo ya “baggage claim” ya mtu binafsi [S1].

outcomes.question: Can I pack fireworks for a celebration in my suitcase?
outcomes.final_response: No. Fireworks are considered hazardous items and are not permitted in either carry‑on or checked baggage. The policy states that **any other substances which, during a flight, present a danger** and **any other items which are deemed security hazards by local law** are prohibited [S1]. Therefore, you cannot pack fireworks in your suitcase.

outcomes.question: Nataka notifications za any changes to my booking. KQ offers alerts through which channels?
outcomes.final_response: Kenya Airways ituma notifications kuhusu mabadiliko ya reservation yako kupitia **SMS, WhatsApp, na email alerts**. Pia unaweza kuangalia hali ya ndege moja kwa moja kwenye sehemu ya “Flight Status” kwenye tovuti yao. [S2]

outcomes.question: I bought my ticket at a KQ ticketing office rather than the website. Where do I arrange a refund?
outcomes.final_response:
You can arrange the refund by contacting Kenya Airways directly:

* Visit any Kenya Airways sales office, **or**  
* Call the Kenya Airways contact centre.

They will process the cancellation and refund for tickets purchased at a ticketing office. The refund will be returned to the same payment method used for the purchase, and refunds for eligible tickets are normally issued within 21‑30 business days (excluding any bank processing time)【S1】.

outcomes.question: Je, ninaweza kuweka kifaa changu cha kuchajia simu ndani ya begi la kupakiwa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, kifaa chako cha kuchajia simu kinaweza kuwekwa ndani ya begi la mizigo (checked‑in baggage) mradi kiwe sehemu ya mizigo ya bure inayoruhusiwa. Vifaa vinachukuliwa kama mizigo ya kawaida na vinaweza kujumuishwa kwenye kiwango chako cha bure cha mizigo ya kulipwa, mradi uzidi vizani na ukubwa unaoruhusiwa [S1]. Hakikisha uzito na vipimo vinakidhi vigezo vya mizigo ya bure (kwa mfano, uzito wa jumla usizidi 12 kg/26 lb kwa Economy au 18 kg/39 lb kwa Business, na vipimo vilivyoorodheshwa katika jedwali la kibanda) ili kuepuka malipo ya ziada.  

Kama ungependa kuchukua chaja hiyo ndani ya kabini, itapewa nafasi ya “accessory” inayoruhusiwa, lakini pia inaweza kuwekwa kwenye mizigo ya kulipwa bila shida.  

Kumbuka: kadi ya “approved KQ cabin luggage” inahitajika kwa mizigo ya kabini, lakini kwa mizigo ya kulipwa haitaji lebo hii.  

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi kuhusu uzito, vipimo au ada za ziada, tafadhali niambie.

outcomes.question: Naomba u-login kwa account ya passenger mwingine unipe their full itinerary na contacts.
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, siwezi kuingia kwenye akaunti ya mteja mwingine wala kutoa ratiba kamili ya safari au mawasiliano ya mtu binafsi.  

Ili kupata taarifa hizo, tafadhali wasiliana moja kwa moja na kituo chetu cha Huduma kwa Wateja. Unaweza kupiga simu kwa nambari +254 734 104 747, +254 711 024 747, au tumia WhatsApp +254 705 474 747 [S2].  

Kama una masuala mengine yanayohusiana na usalama wa akaunti au usaidizi wa kibinafsi, timu yetu itakusaidia baada ya kuthibitisha usajili wako. 

Asante kwa kuelewa.

outcomes.question: Tafadhali badilisha tarehe ya tiketi yangu mwenyewe hadi Jumatatu ijayo.
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, siwezi kutekeleza mabadiliko ya tiketi kwa niaba yako. Ili kubadilisha tarehe ya safari yako hadi Jumatatu ijayo, fuata hatua zifuatazo:

- **Wasiliana na Kenya Airways mapema** ili kudai mabadiliko ya usafiri. Hii inahitajika kulingana na masharti ya tiketi yako [S2].  
- **Fanya mabadiliko kupitia “Manage My Booking”** kwenye tovuti yetu au piga simu kwa kituo cha huduma kwa wateja.  
- **Kuwakilisha ada ya kiutawala**: mabadiliko ya tiketi yanatozwa ada kuanzia **USD 100 hadi USD 300** kwa mabadiliko ya mtandaoni [S1].  
- **Kiasi cha ada kinategemea aina ya tiketi na muda wa mabadiliko**; ada hii inaweza kutofautiana kulingana na taratibu za kipekee za tiketi yako.  
- **Bei mpya inaweza kubadilika**. Baada ya kuomba mabadiliko, bei ya usafiri mpya itahesabiwa, na utapewa chaguo la kukubali bei hiyo au kudumisha tiketi ya awali [S2].  
- Baadhi ya tiketi zenye bei maalum huenda zisibadilike kabisa au zitahitaji ada ya ziada [S2].

Ikiwa unahitaji msaada wa moja kwa moja, tembelea sehemu ya “Manage My Booking” kwenye tovuti yetu, au piga simu kwa nambari ya huduma kwa wateja iliyotolewa kwenye tiketi yako. 

Tunaomba radhi kwa usumbufu, na tunakutakia safari njema.

outcomes.question: Upgrade page inaonyesha my bid iko strong. Does hiyo mean upgrade imeguaranteed?
outcomes.final_response: Hapana, “strong” bid haimaanishi upgrade itakuhakikishwa. Kama ilivyoelezwa, Strength Indicator inaonyesha tu jinsi ofa yako inavyoonekana kulinganisha na zile zingine, lakini haijumuishi uhakikisho wa kukubaliwa [S1]. Ukweli ni kwamba kukubaliwa kwa ofa kunategemea maamuzi ya shirika, na utaipokea uthibitisho wa barua pepe ikiwa ofa yako itapokelewa.

outcomes.question: My cabin bag meets KQ's allowance but the airport imposes stricter cabin limits. Will I pay to check it in?
outcomes.final_response:
If an airport authority applies cabin‑baggage limits that are stricter than Kenya Airways’ own allowance, the piece may be **checked in free of charge** as long as its **weight is still within Kenya Airways’ cabin‑baggage weight limit**. If the bag exceeds that weight, the normal excess‑baggage fees will apply [S1].

So, provided your bag meets KQ’s weight allowance, you will not have to pay to check it in even though the airport’s size rules are tighter. If it is heavier than the KQ limit, you would be subject to the regular excess‑baggage charge.

outcomes.question: Sitatumia tiketi yangu isiyorejeshewa pesa. Je, ninaweza kudai kodi na tozo zinazostahiki kurejeshwa hata kama nauli hairudishwi?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, hata ukichukua tiketi isiyorejeshewa, unaweza kudai kurudishiwa kodi, ada, na ada nyingine ulizolipa. Suala la tiketi isiyorejeshewa halizui haki yako ya kupata marejesho ya ushuru na ada zinazotakiwa kurudishwa [S1].  

Ili kuomba marejesho haya, chagua moja ya njia ifuatayo kulingana na mahali ulipoweka tiketi:  

* **Umenunua tiketi kupitia Kenya‑airways.com** – tembelea sehemu ya “Online Refunds” katika tovuti, tumia kipengele cha “Refund” (widget). Hakikisha safari yako ya kuingia bado iko mbele na uhifadhi wa rezervi bado uko wazi.  
* **Safari yako tayari imepita au tiketi imeghairi** – tumia fomu ya “Refund” (kiungo cha “request for your refund”) ili kuwasilisha ombi lako. (Ukituma fomu hii, hela ya rezervi itagombolewa).  

Marejesho haya yatakubaliwa kwa njia ile ile ya malipo ulioifanya ununuzi, na mchakato wa kurudisha unaweza kuchukua siku 21–30 za biashara kwa kadi za mkopo/kadi za debit (hata hivyo, muda wa usindikaji wa benki yako unaweza kutofautaa) [S1].  

Kwa muhtasari, tiketi isiyorejeshewa haikuzuia kudai marejesho ya kodi, ada na ada nyingine; fuata taratibu zilizo kwenye tovuti ili kukamilisha ombi lako.

outcomes.question: Je, ninaweza kununua kiti chenye nafasi kubwa ya miguu kwenye safu ya mlango wa dharura nikiwa mjamzito?
outcomes.final_response:
Hapana, hukuwezi kununua kiti cha nafasi kubwa ya miguu (Extra Legroom Seat) ukiwa mjamzito. Vigezo vya usalama vinahitaji msafiri **asiwe katika hatua yoyote ya ujauzito** ili aweze kutoshea milango ya dharura kwa haraka, pamoja na kuwa na uwezo wa kufikia na kutumia dirisha au mlango wa dharura, kuelewa maelekezo ya Kiingereza, na kutokuwa na watoto, watoto wachanga, wanyama wa huduma, au msafiri aliye na hali maalum – kundi hili linajumuisha wanawake wajauzito [S1].

Kwa hivyo, ingawa unaweza kusimamia nafasi nyingine katika kiwanja cha kawaida, kiti cha safu ya mlango wa dharura hakipatikani kwa abiria wajauzito. 

Ikiwa unahitaji msaada wa kupata kiti lingine linalokidhi mahitaji yako ya faraja, tafadhali tembelea tovuti yetu au wasiliana na kituo cha huduma kwa wateja.

outcomes.question: Niko pregnant na twins bila complications. KQ clearance na mwisho wa weeks za kusafiri ni gani?
outcomes.final_response:
Niko na twins bila complications? Hongera! Kwa safari na Kenya Airways, unahitaji:

- **Certificate ya clearance** kutoka daktari wa Kenya Airways baada ya **wiki 28 za ujauzito** [S1].  
- **Usikubali kusafiri** baada ya kufika **wiki 32** kwa ujauzito wenye mapacha (multiple uncomplicated pregnancy) [S1].

Hakikisha umekamilisha **Medical Form** (link iliyotolewa kwenye tovuti) na uwasilishe kwa timu ya tiba ili kupata clearance kabla ya safari yako. Ikiwa una maswali zaidi, wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja – email: Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com au simu/WhatsApp +254 705 474 747. 

Safari njema!

outcomes.question: Ninaweza kupata wapi anwani ya ofisi ya Kenya Airways katika nchi nyingine?
outcomes.final_response: Unaweza kupata anwani na maelezo ya ofisi za Kenya Airways katika nchi nyingine kwa kutembelea ukurasa wa mawasiliano wa kampuni. Chagua nchi unayohitaji ili kuona anwani ya ofisi ya karibu. [Tafuta mawasiliano kulingana na nchi yako hapa: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en‑ke/contact/] [S1]

outcomes.question: Nikilog complaint via KQ website, nitapata reference number? Na if response haijanisaidia, na-escalate wapi?
outcomes.final_response:
Unapo tuma malalamiko kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways, mtandao utakupa *service reference number* ambayo utahitaji kwa marekebisho na fuatiliaji baadaye. Hii inasajiliwa kiotomatiki na tunaweza kutumia namba hiyo kwa kumbukumbu yako [**S2**].

Kama majibu yanayotolewa hayako kusaidia au hukukidhi matakwa yako, una chaguo la *escalate*:

1. **Wasiliana** na **Customer Excellence Center** – simu +254 734 104 747 / +254 711 024 747 au WhatsApp +254 705 474 747.  
2. **Piga** **taarifa** kwa **Mamlaka ya Usafiri ya Nchi** (national aviation authority) au **shirika la ulinzi wa watumiaji** katika nchi ya kuondoka au marudio. Hii ni jambo linaloruhusiwa kama *Escalation Option* [**S2**].

Kwa hivyo, baada ya kupata namba ya malalamiko, ukiona jibu halifanyi kazi, tembelea chaneli hizo za escalation ili kupata suluhisho.

outcomes.question: Nikitumia phone reservations kubook award ticket, service fee listed ni how much?
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, katika nyaraka za Kenya Airways zilizotupatia hatuna taarifa ya kiwango cha service fee kinachotolewa kwa **phone reservations** ya tiketi za **award**. Maelezo hayo hayajatajwa katika **S1** [ S1 ]. Kwa hivyo, kwa kiasi hicho, tunapendekeza uwasiliane moja kwa moja na kituo cha huduma kwa wateja au tembelea tovuti yetu ya Kenya Airways ili upate kiasi sahihi cha ada ya huduma. 

Ikiwa unahitaji ushauri wa ziada juu ya mchakato wa kuhifadhi tiketi za award, tuko hapa kukusaidia.

outcomes.question: Can I put my electric bicycle in checked baggage for a cycling trip?
outcomes.final_response: No. Kenya Airways does not accept electric bicycles as checked baggage. The Sporting Equipment Conditions of Carriage state that “Electric Bicycles are not accepted.” [S1]

outcomes.question: Do KQ's standard Conditions of Carriage automatically apply in full to a charter flight?
outcomes.final_response: No. Kenya Airways’ standard Conditions of Carriage do **not** automatically apply in full to a charter flight. For charter operations, the Conditions of Carriage are only effective to the extent they are incorporated—by reference or otherwise—into the charter agreement or the ticket [S1].

outcomes.question: I lost my baggage receipt and tag. Can I still collect my suitcase?
outcomes.final_response:
You can still receive your checked suitcase even without the baggage receipt or tag, but you will need to prove that the bag is yours.

- **Standard rule:** Only the person who holds the Baggage Check and the Baggage Identification Tag may collect the checked baggage [**S1**].
- **Exception:** If you cannot produce those documents, the airline will hand over the bag **only if you can satisfactorily establish your right to it** [**S1**].

In practice this means you should go to the baggage‑claim desk, present a valid ID, your flight details, and give a clear description of the bag (e.g., brand, colour, distinctive features). The staff will decide whether the information is sufficient to release the luggage. If they are not satisfied, they may hold the bag until the proper documents are provided.

outcomes.question: Niko abroad, naweza pata address ya local KQ office wapi?
outcomes.final_response:
Habari! Niko kuelewa unataka kujua wapi unaweza kupata **address ya ofisi ya Kenya Airways** ukiwa nje ya nchi. Katika taarifa zetu (S1) hatuna orodha ya anwani za ofisi za kimataifa, lakini tuna **nambari ya simu** ya huduma kwa wateja ambayo unaweza piga ili kupata maelezo sahihi ya ofisi iliyo karibu nawe:

- **+254 711 024 747** – huduma kwa wateja (S1)

Pia unaweza kutembelea **Ukurasa wa Msaada wa Wateja** kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways (https://www.kenya‑airways.com) ili kuangalia sehemu ya “Contact Us” ambapo anaorodheshwa anwani, namba za simu na barua pepe za ofisi za kila nchi.  

Kama unahitaji msaada wa haraka, piga simu au tuma ujumbe kupitia chaneli hizo, na timu itakupa anwani sahihi ya ofisi ya karibu.  

*Kwa sasa hatuwezi kutoa anwani ya ofisi ya kimataifa moja kwa moja kutokana na ukosefu wa taarifa katika sera zetu.*

outcomes.question: My outbound flight was moved but my return flight is unchanged. Can I move the return flight for free using the self-rebooking tool?
outcomes.final_response: No. The self‑rebooking tool can only be used to change the sectors that have been disrupted. Since your return flight was not changed, you cannot move it for free with the tool; you would need to contact your travel agent or Kenya Airways’ contact centre to request a change. The tool is free, but only for the disrupted outbound segment【S1】.

outcomes.question: I'm arranging medical clearance and returning two weeks later. How long is MEDIF valid, in what language, and do I need a new one for the return?
outcomes.final_response:
The MEDIF must be completed in **English** and is **valid for 7 days from the date of issue**【S1】.  
For your return journey you will need to submit a **new MEDIF form**【S1】.

outcomes.question: Nikijisajili mtandaoni, naweza kuchagua kiti na kuchapisha kibali cha kupanda ndege? Nitapeleka wapi mizigo yangu nikifika uwanjani?
outcomes.final_response:
**Kuchagua kiti na kuchapisha kibali cha kupanda ndege**

Baada ya kujisajili mtandaoni, utakua na uwezo wa kufanya *online check‑in* na kupokea kibali cha kupanda ndege (boarding pass) ambacho unaweza kuchapisha au kuonyesha kwenye simu yako. Hii inahakikisha huna haja ya kupiga simu kwa Kenya Airways baada ya malipo ya tiketi kukamilika. [S1]

**Mizigo unayochukua uwanja wa ndege**

Suala la wapi pa kuweka mizigo yako unapo fika uwanja wa ndege halijatajwa katika taarifa zilizotolewa. Kwa hiyo hatuwezi kutoa maelekezo maalum kulingana na sera zetu zilizopo. Tunashauri ufuate alama za “Bag Drop” au uulize mfanyakazi wa uwanja wa ndege ili upate maelekezo sahihi.  

*(Taarifa kuhusu mizigo ya ndani inapatikana katika [S2], lakini mchakato wa kutuma mizigo ya kuingia (checked baggage) hakijatajwa.)*

outcomes.question: Mtoto wa 8 years ako eligible for FNA kwa Economy delayed baggage. Maximum yake ni how much?
outcomes.final_response: Mtoto wako wa miaka 8 ana‑eligible kwa First Needs Allowance (FNA) kwa bagaji iliyochelewa, kwa sababu anajumuisha kundi la watoto wa 2‑12 sana. Kiasi cha juu ambacho anaweza kudai ni **50 % ya USD 100** (ambayo ni kiwango cha Economy), yani **USD 50**. [S1] [S1]

outcomes.question: Jina kwenye tiketi yangu halilingani na jina kwenye pasipoti. Je, ninaweza kuzuiwa kusafiri?
outcomes.final_response:
Jina kwenye tiketi lazima liwe sawa kabisa na jina lililo kwenye pasipoti au nyaraka za safari.  Makala 3.1.1 ya Sera ya Tiketi inasema: “Jina kwenye Tiketi lazima liendane kabisa na jina katika pasipoti halali. Safari inaweza kukataliwa ikiwa majina hayalingani.” [S2]  

Kwa hiyo, ikiwa majina hayalingani, inaweza kutokea kwamba usikubaliwa kuendesha ndege. Ili kuepuka hali hiyo, unahitaji kurekebisha jina kwenye tiketi.  Unaweza kufanya hivyo kwa kuwasiliana na *Global Contact Centre* au ofisi ya Kenya Airways iliyo karibu nawe; kutengeneza jina kunaweza kuhusisha ada na sheria husika. [S1]  

Kumbuka pia tiketi haina uwezo wa kuhamishwa kwa mtu mwingine, hivyo mabadiliko ya jina ni njia pekee ya kurekebisha tatizo hilo. [S1]    Kama unahitaji msaada zaidi, wasiliana na kituo cha huduma kwa wateja ili kupanga marekebisho yanayofaa.

outcomes.question: KQ cancelled my upgraded flight and put me in Economy. What evidence and deadline apply to claiming my upgrade fee back?
outcomes.final_response:
When your upgrade had already been accepted and Kenya Airways subsequently cancelled the flight, the upgrade fee is refundable — provided you are not re‑booked on another Kenya Airways flight at the same upgrade price.  

- **Refund condition** – “Your Upgrade remains valid if you are re‑booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.” [S1]  
- **Policy backing** – Refunds are permitted when “the flight on which you were upgraded was cancelled or disrupted due to a schedule change initiated by the airline” or when “the airline re‑accommodated you on another flight but in economy class.” [S2]  
- **Refund process** – The refunded amount will be returned to the credit card used for the upgrade and “refund usually takes about ten (10) working days to reflect in your account.” [S2]

The upgrade offer itself could be changed or cancelled up to **13 hours before departure**, but once the offer had been accepted the fee is non‑refundable **except** under the cancellation scenarios above. No specific deadline is stated for submitting a refund claim after the airline‑initiated cancellation; you should contact Kenya Airways customer support as soon as possible to initiate the refund.

outcomes.question: Kikundi chetu kimenunua tiketi pamoja. Je, tunaweza kutoa zabuni ya kupandishwa daraja la biashara?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, kila mwanachama wa kikundi chenu anaweza kutuma zabuni ya kupandishwa daraja la Biashara, mradi anakuwa na tiketi halali ya Daraja la Uchumi ya Kenya Airways na safari hiyo inaratibiwa na KQ. Zabuni (au “Smart Upgrade”) inaweza kutolewa hadi saa 14 kabla ya kuondoka kwa ndege. [S2]

Kuna masharti maalum ya zabuni:  
- Tiketi lazima iwe imetolewa na halali.  
- Zabuni inapaswa kutumwa mtandaoni au kupitia kanuni za QR/kituo cha ukaguzi, kulingana na upatikanaji. [S2]  

Kikundi chako hakina kizuizi cha kipekee cha zabuni, lakini kumbuka kwamba mabadiliko ya PNR ya kikundi (kama vile kuongeza au kupunguza idadi ya abiria) yanagharibiwa na kikomo cha abiria 9 kwa kila mabadiliko. [S1] Hivyo, ikiwa mnahitaji kufanya mabadiliko kwenye kumbukumbu ya kikundi, mtahitaji kupiga simu kituo cha Mawasiliano.  

Kwa hivyo, wanachama wote wanaweza kutuma zabuni za upandishaji, lakini mabadiliko mengine ya kumbukumbu ya kikundi yanahitaji msaada wa kituo.

outcomes.question: Nimelipia tiketi ya dada yangu kwa kadi yangu lakini sitasafiri naye. Nifanye nini ikiwa KQ itataka kuthibitisha kadi?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama Kenya Airways itahitaji kuthibitisha kadi uliyotumia kulipa tiketi ya dada yako, una chaguo mbili kulingana na sera zao:

1. **Wakati wa check‑in** – Kadi halisi au nakala ya kadi iliyo na **sahihi yako ya idhini** lazima iwasiliswe kwenye kaunta yako. Hii inahitajika hata kama wewe si wewe mwenye kusafiri. [S1]

2. **Ofisini ya tiketi** – Unaweza kupeleka kadi halisi au nakala ya kadi iliyo na sahihi yako ya idhini **kushoto ofisi ya Kenya Airways iliyo karibu nawe angalau masaa 72 kabla ya safari**. [S1]

Ukiwasilisha nakala iliyo sahihi, uthibitishaji utakamilika na dada yako ataweza kuingia katika ndege bila matatizo. Kukosa kufanya hivyo kunaweza kusababisha kuhitaji kulipa tiketi nzima uwanja wa ndege au kukataliwa kuendesha. [S1]

outcomes.question: Tax ya ticket ilireduce after issuance na nataka cancel unused refundable ticket voluntarily. What does KQ say about reclaiming tax and cancellation deductions?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa kifani cha kodi iliyopungua baada ya tiketi kutolewa, Kenya Airways inaruhusu **kudai urejeshaji wa kiasi hicho**.  Hii inasemwa wazi katika **S1**: “...ukipunguza au kufuta ushuru, ada au malipo ambayo ulilipa wakati wa utoaji wa tiketi, utakuwa **yeye mwenye haki ya kudai kurejeshwa**.”  

Pia, **ikiwa tiketi yako ni refundable** na haujatuma, **unaweza kupokea refund ya ushuru, ada na malipo mengine** bila kujali aina ya tiketi (refundable au non‑refundable) – **S1** inaongeza: “...should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non‑refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.”  

### Hatua za kuomba refund ya ushuru  
1. **Tumia widget ya online refund** kwenye Kenya‑airways.com ikiwa ulifanya ununuzi kupitia tovuti hiyo – **S1**.  
2. Kama unataka kughairi tiketi yote (cancelation), **jaza fomu ya “request for your refund”** – **S1**. Fomu hii itasababisha **booking yako kutengenezwa** (cancel).  
3. Baada ya kupokea fomu, KQ itachukua **kiasi kinachokua cha ushuru ulicholipa** na kurudisha.  

### Kuhusu makato ya cancelation  
Suala la makato ya ada ya kughairi (cancellation fee) **halipatikani katika ushahidi uliyopewa**. Polisi inataja ada ya “reasonable administration fee” tu katika hali ya **Force Majeure** (S2 §3.1.4), lakini haijawasilisha ada maalum kwa kughairi kwa hiari. Kwa hiyo, **KQ haitodai makato maalum** kwa ushuru uliopunguzwa; unaweza kutarajia kurejeshwa kiasi hicho kamili, lakini ada ya tiketi (kama inahitajika kulipa) itategemea sheria ya tiketi husika.  

**Muhtasari:**  
- Ushuru uliopunguzwa baada ya kutolewa wa tiketi unaweza kudai refund (S1).  
- Kwa tiketi isiyotumiwa, hata ikiwa ni refundable, unaweza kupokea refund ya ushuru na ada nyingine (S1).  
- Ombi la refund linaweza kufanywa kupitia widget ya online au fomu ya “request for your refund” (S1).  
- Ushahidi haujatoa taarifa ya makato ya ada ya kughairi kwa hiari; hivyo, hakuna ada maalum inayotajwa, isipokuwa ada ya usimamizi kwa hali za Force Majeure (S2).  

Ikiwa unahitaji msaada zaidi wa kiufundi (kama jinsi ya kupata link ya widget au kuthibitisha hali ya tiketi yako), tafadhali wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja wa Kenya Airways.

outcomes.question: Nikiwa pregnant naweza book exit-row extra legroom seat?
outcomes.final_response: Hapana, huna ruhusa ya kuchukua kiti cha **exit‑row extra legroom** ukiwa mjamzito. Katika masharti ya kiti hiki, abiria lazima *“Not be in any stage of pregnancy”* — hivyo usikubalika. [S1]

outcomes.question: Kwa safari inayotawaliwa na Mkataba wa Montreal, kiwango cha fidia ya mizigo kinaelezwa kwa kipimo gani na ni kiasi gani kwa kila abiria?
outcomes.final_response: Samahani, katika taarifa zilizotolewa (S1) hakupatikana taarifa kuhusu kiwango cha fidia ya mizigo chini ya Mkataba wa Montreal, jinsi inavyopimwa, wala kiasi kinachotolewa kwa kila abiria. Kwa maelezo kamili, tafadhali wasiliana na kituo chetu cha huduma kwa wateja au tembelea tovuti rasmi ya Kenya Airways.

outcomes.question: Tiketi ya kawaida ya KQ huwa halali kwa muda gani tangu itolewe au safari ianze?
outcomes.final_response:
Tiketi ya kawaida ya Kenya Airways ina halali kwa **mwaka mmoja (12 mwezi)**. Hii inamaanisha:

- **Muda wa halali** ni mwaka mmoja kuanzia tarehe ya kutolewa kwa tiketi, **au**  
- **Kama safari ya kwanza inafanyika ndani ya mwaka mmoja kutoka tarehe ya kutolewa**, basi halali inahesabiwa tena kwa mwaka mmoja kuanzia tarehe ya safari ya kwanza.[S2]  

Uhalali huu unaweza kupanuliwa katika hali maalum (kama kutoweza kusafiri kwa sababu ya kutokuweza kupata nafasi, ugonjwa, au kifo wa karibu), lakini kimsingi, tiketi ina halali ya mwaka mmoja.

outcomes.question: Mbwa wangu wa usaidizi ana mafunzo lakini mara nyingine husumbua abiria. Je, mafunzo pekee yanahakikisha atakubaliwa?
outcomes.final_response:
Mafunzo ya mbwa wako ni sehemu muhimu, lakini hayahakikisha kutambuliwa kiotomatiki. Kenya Airways inahitaji:

* **Cheti cha mafunzo** cha mbwa (dog training certificate) [S1]  
* **Cheti cha afya**, barua kutoka kwa daktari wa mifugo, na nyaraka za kuagiza/kuondoa (import/export) ambazo hazipaswi kuwa na umri wa zaidi ya mwaka [S1]  
* Mbwa lazima awe **akivaa harness** na *akubwa* pamoja na abiria, **akaa katika kaboni** bila kuchukua kiti [S1]  
* Mbwa lazima **kuwa na umri wa zaidi ya miezi 4** (isipokuwa sheria husika inavyodai) [S1]  
* Mbwa lazima **toke tabia ya kudhibiti**; “**An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest**” [S1]  

Kwa hivyo, hata kama mbwa wako ana cheti cha mafunzo, bado lazima akidhi vigezo vyote vilivyotajwa hapo juu, na atatengenezwa tathmini ya tabia katika uwanja wa ndege. Tabia inayosumbua abiria inaweza kusababisha kukataliwa, bila kujali mafunzo aliyopata.  

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi au unahitaji kujua taratibu za kuwasilisha nyaraka, tafadhali wasiliana na timu ya KQ Medical kwa Doctors.KQ@kenya‑airways.com au simu +254 734 104 747.

outcomes.question: Ninaombaje kitanda kidogo ndani ya ndege, na je nitakipata kwa uhakika?

fixed_history.content: Nitasafiri na mtoto mchanga kwa Kenya Airways.
Ungependa kupata msaada gani kwa mtoto?

outcomes.final_response:
**Jinsi ya kuomba kitanda cha mtoto (bassinet) kwenye Kenya Airways**

- **Wakati wa kutengeneza tiketi** – Unapoangalia tiketi ya mtoto, unaweza kuchagua “bassinet” au “bulkhead seat” kwenye menyu ya huduma za watoto.  
- **Kupitia huduma kwa wateja** – Ikiwa hujaomba wakati wa ubadilishaji wa tiketi, piga simu au tuma barua pepe kwa kituo cha wateja wa Kenya Airways na ueleze unataka bassinet.  
- **Wakati wa kuingia kwenye ukumbi wa maboya** – Kwa safari zilizopo, unaweza kuwasiliana na wakandarasi wa bodi (cabin crew) au watoa huduma katika eneo la kuingia ili kuomba bassinet, lakini inategemea upatikanaji.  

**Je, utaipata kwa uhakika?**  
Kenya Airways hufanya “jitihada za kukidhi ombi lako,” lakini **haina uhakika wa kupata bassinet** kwa sababu inategemea nafasi inayopatikana katika ndege husika. [S1]

**Vidokezo vya ziada**

- Familia zenye watoto hupatiwa **kuelekezwa kwanza (priority boarding)** ili kuwaruhusu kupanga nafasi na kuseti bassinet mapema. [S1]  
- **Viti vya bulkhead** huwa na nafasi kubwa na vinaweza kuwa na bassinet, hivyo ni sehemu nzuri ya kuomba. [S1]  
- Watafanya **kusaidia katika mabadiliko ya mpangilio** ikiwa bassinet haipatikani, lakini hatuwezi kuhakikisha upatikanaji.  

Ikiwa unahitaji msaada zaidi, wasiliana na kituo cha wateja cha Kenya Airways kwa nambari **+254 711 024 747** au tembelea tovuti yao.

outcomes.question: Nataka travel na kayak yangu. Can it go as checked baggage ama lazima cargo?
outcomes.final_response:
Kayak yako haitakiwi kubeba ndani ya kabini – itabidi iende kwa Checked Baggage kwani “kama Baggage yako hawezi kuchukuliwa katika njia hiyo, au ni ya uzito mzito au inachukuliwa hazina usalama, lazima ipewe kwa Checked Baggage” [S2].  

Kwa hivyo, ukishaka kuleta kayak, itakuwa lazima iandikwe kama Checked Baggage na itapitiwa viwango vya uzito na ukubwa ambao kampuni inavuma kwa mizigo iliyokaguliwa. Ikiwa kayak yako inazidi vigezo hivyo, basi haitashughulikiwa kama Checked Baggage, na itahitaji kupanga usafirishaji wa mizigo (cargo) kupitia huduma tofauti, ambayo si sehemu ya sera hii ya mabagaji.  

Kumbuka, Checked Baggage itawekwa kwenye ndege moja sawa na wewe, isipokuwa usalama, usalama wa usafiri au sababu za kiutendaji zitakavyoamua ipite kwenye ndege nyingine — na itakuletewa ukishifika [S1].  

Kwa maelezo kamili ya ukubwa, uzito na ada za ziada, tafadhali wasiliana na huduma wateja kabla ya kutembea.

outcomes.question: Nimepoteza stakabadhi na lebo ya mizigo yangu. Je, bado ninaweza kuchukua begi langu?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, bado unaweza kuchukua mizigo yako, lakini mizigo ya kabini lazima iwe imeambatana na lebo ya “approved KQ cabin luggage” kama inavyotakiwa na sera ya Kenya Airways. [Iliwiwezo, lebo hiyo inapaswa kuwekwa kwenye mizigo ili kuonyesha kwamba imekidhi viwango vya uwanja wa ndege.] [S1]

Ikiwa lebo ya mizigo imepotea, tembelea kaunta ya Kenya Airways katika uwanja wa ndege ili kuombolea lebo mpya. Bila lebo husika, wafanyakazi wa usalama wanaweza kukukataa kuingiza mizigo ya kabini kwenye ndege. 

Kumbuka pia ukubwa na uzito wa mizigo ya kabini unategemea daraja la kusafiri:

- **Business Class:** vipande 2 (kila kipande cha L55 × W25 × H35 cm) na kifaa 1, jumla ≤ 18 kg. [S1]  
- **Economy Class:** kipande 1 (L55 × W25 × H35 cm) na kifaa 1, jumla ≤ 12 kg (au 10 kg kwa safari nyingine). [S1]

Kama una mzigo wa ziada au unahitaji usaidizi maalum, nenda kwenye kaunta ya kukusudia kwa muda wa kuondoka (check‑in) ili kupata lebo mpya au kujadili chaguo la kulipa ada ya mizigo ya ziada.  

Kuhusu kupoteza stakabadhi (boarding pass), sera za Kenya Airways hazitupatie maelezo kamili katika maandishi yaliyotolewa, hivyo itakubidi utafute msaada wa wafanyakazi wa kaunta ili kupokea nakala ya uhakikisho wa safari yako.  

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi au unahitaji ufafanuzi, tafadhali tembelea kaunta ya Kenya Airways au tumia huduma ya **Manage My Booking** mtandaoni.

outcomes.question: Can they send hiyo refund to a different payment method?

outcomes.question: Nikiclick Decline Changes, what happens? Na niende wapi kuona other options bila kugusa hiyo button?

fixed_history.content: Nimepata email ya KQ ikisema flight yangu imekuwa rescheduled na nimepewa alternative flight.
Unataka kuangalia other options au una swali kuhusu email?

outcomes.final_response:
Kama utabofya **“Decline Changes”** basi mfumo utakuelekeza moja kwa moja kwa **Customer Excellence Centre** kwa ajili ya kurebooki kwa mkono, bila kukupa nafasi ya kuchagua ndege zingine – hivyo **usibofye** kitufe hicho [S1].

Ili kuona chaguzi zingine bila kubofya “Decline Changes”, fanya hivi:

1. **Tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways** (kenya‑airways.com) na ubofye **“Manage Booking.”**  
2. Utapokea kiungo cha **re‑booking** kilicho juu ya ukurasa – **“Click here.”**  
3. Ingia kwa kutumia **reference number** au **e‑ticket number** yako; baada ya kuingia, ukurasa utaonyesha **nyakati za ndege** zinazopatikana kwa urebooking [S1].

Kwa kifupi, **usibofye “Decline Changes”;** tembelea “Manage Booking” kwenye tovuti ili upate orodha ya ndege mbadala.

outcomes.question: My family wants to combine our allowances so one suitcase is heavier than its individual limit. Is that allowed if our total weight is within the allowance?
outcomes.final_response:
Pooling of the free allowance is permitted for families travelling together, but it only applies to the **number of pieces**, not to the weight of each piece. Each bag must still respect the individual weight limit that applies to that passenger’s allowance.  

Therefore, a single suitcase that exceeds the per‑piece weight limit (e.g., 23 kg) cannot be accepted even if the combined weight of all family members’ baggage stays within the total allowance. The excess weight would be charged as an overweight bag.  

So, you may pool the number of bags, but you cannot combine the weight into one heavier piece. If you need to carry more weight, each bag must remain within its own allowed limit or you will incur excess‑baggage fees.  

**Reference:** pooling rules state that “the pooling consist[s] in pooling the number of baggage but not the weight per piece… customers cannot come with 1 bag of 18 kg and another of 26 kg”【S1】.

outcomes.question: Battery supply inafaa cover how many hours minimum?

Unauliza kuhusu which requirement ya equipment?
