outcomes.question: Nimetoa zabuni ya kubadili daraja la safari lakini bado haijakubaliwa. Je, ninaweza kuibadilisha au kuifuta?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, unaweza kubadilisha au kuondoa zabuni yako ya **Upgrade to Business Class** mradi haijapokelewa (haijathibitishwa) na KQ.

- **Kubadilisha kiasi**: Unaweza kubadilisha kiasi cha zabuni kabla ya kupokea barua pepe ya uthibitisho. Tumia kiungo kilicho kwenye barua pepe ya ofa ya upgrade ili kubadilisha bei. [S1]

- **Kusitisha (kuondoa) zabuni**: Unaweza kubatilisha au kurekebisha zabuni hadi saa 13 kabla ya muda wa kuondoka, mradi zabuni bado haijapokelewa. [S1][S2]

Kumbuka, baada ya ofa yako kupokelewa na kuthibitishwa na KQ, hautaweza kubatilisha au kurekebisha, na kiasi kitatozwa bila kurejeshwa. [S1][S2]

outcomes.question: I bought a return ticket on KQ's website and the return date is still in the future. Can I request an online refund without cancelling the other open segments?
outcomes.final_response:
You can apply for an online refund through the refund widget because the ticket was purchased on kenya‑airways.com and your inbound (return) travel is still in the future and the booking is active [S1].  

However, when you use the **Cancel and refund** option in “Modify My Booking”, the system treats the ticket as a whole – if the ticket is open, **all sectors are cancelled** and the entire booking is refunded [S1]. In other words, you cannot refund only the return leg while keeping the outbound segment active; the refund process will cancel the whole itinerary.  

If you wish to keep any part of the journey, you would need to explore a change or re‑booking instead of a refund, or contact a preferred travel agent or sales office for assistance [S1]. Refunds, when approved, are credited to the original form of payment and are subject to the fare conditions [S1].

outcomes.question: I want to fly with a 50-inch TV in its original box. What conditions apply?
outcomes.final_response:
A 50‑inch TV in its original box is treated as baggage, and the airline may refuse to carry it if, in its reasonable opinion, the item is unsuitable because of its size, shape, weight, contents, or for safety or operational reasons [S1].  

The TV must be packed securely in a suitable container; if the airline considers the packaging inadequate, it can also refuse carriage [S1].  

If the TV is damaged, becomes hot, produces smoke, is lost, or falls into the seat structure, you must inform cabin crew immediately [S1].  

You can request detailed information about items that are unacceptable or about packing requirements [S1].

outcomes.question: I'm Asante Gold, flying out of Nairobi with a companion. What priority benefits are described and what should I show at the counter?
outcomes.final_response:
As an Asante Gold member departing from Nairobi you are entitled to the following priority benefits:

* **Priority check‑in** and **priority boarding**.  
* **Lounge access** for you and one accompanying guest.  
* The option to **request a business‑class upgrade** if you have enough miles.

At the airport you simply need to **present your Asante Rewards card at the check‑in counter** – this automatically registers your miles and grants you the above privileges【S1】.

outcomes.question: Nataka kusafiri na mtoto. Ni masharti gani?
outcomes.final_response:
**Masharti ya kusafiri na mtoto (kwa Kenya Airways)**  

- **Umri wa mtoto**  
  - Watoto wa umri wa **5 hadi 14 sana** wanaweza kusafiri peke yao kupitia huduma ya *Unaccompanied Minor*. [S1]  
  - Watoto **chini ya 5 sana** lazima waende na mlezi aliyeko pamoja naye. [S1]

- **Nyaraka zinazohitajika**  
  - Jaza **Fomu ya Unaccompanied Minor** (inapatikana kwenye tovuti). Fomu hiyo ina maelezo kuhusu mtoto, mlezi, na mtu atakayemupeleka/akampokea. [S1]  
  - Huduma hii inapatikana **tu kwa ndege zinazoendeshwa na Kenya Airways**. [S1]

- **Ada na usaidizi**  
  - Huduma ya usimamizi wa usafiri wa mtoto inashughulikiwa na timu maalum, ikijumuisha ukusanyaji wa taarifa za mtoto, mlezi, na mtu wa kuchukua mtoto. [S1]  

- **Kama mtoto yuko chini ya umri wa 2 sana (infant)**  
  - Anaweza kusafiri **kama “lap infant”** – usafiri wa mtoto aliyekaa kwenye kifua cha mzazi. Sheria za tiketi, mizigo, na umri zinapatikana kwenye sera ya “Lap Infant Policies”. [S1]  
  - **Familia inaweza kupanda ndege mapema** (pre‑boarding) ili kupata muda wa kuandaa na kumaliza maandalizi. [S1]  
  - **Mlo maalum** kwa watoto ambao wameanza kula vyakula thabiti unaweza kuagizwa mapema. [S1]  
  - **Msaada wa wafanyakazi wa kabini**: Wanaweza kusaidia kupasha chupa, kupunguza shinikizo la masikio (kupiga pombe au kutumia pacifier) na kutoa maelekezo mengine ya utulivu. [S1]  
  - **Vifaa vya usafi na ubora**: Tofali za kusafisha na kubadilisha mtoto zinapatikana katika vyoo vya ndege. [S1]  

- **Mchakato wa uwasilishaji**  
  - Mtu atakayemupeleke mtoto katika uwanja wa kutua au kutua lazima **awahi kufika kabla ya ndege kutimua** ili kuwezesha usambazaji salama. [S1]  

- **Mikataba ya dharura**  
  - Ikiwa kutatokea usumbufu, wafanyakazi watafuata taratibu za dharura kuhakikisha usalama wa mtoto, pamoja na mawasiliano ya mara kwa mara na mlezi na mtu wa kuchukua. [S1]  

Kwa muhtasari, ikiwa mtoto yuko kati ya miaka 5–14 na anasafiri peke yake, anahitaji fomu ya Unaccompanied Minor na huduma hii inapatikana tu kwa ndege zetu. Watoto walio chini ya miaka 5, pamoja na watoto wachanga (infants), wanahitaji kuwa na mlezi, na wanaweza kufaidika na huduma za familia pre‑board, milo maalum, na msaada wa wafanyakazi. 

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi au unahitaji maelezo ya ziada, tafadhali nijulishe.

outcomes.question: Can I reserve a ticket online and pay cash later? What should I bring and are there fees?
outcomes.final_response:
You cannot hold a reservation on Kenya Airways website without paying for it first. Tickets are issued only after the payment has been received; a “pay‑later‑in‑cash” option is not described in the available policy.

When you do pay online, the ticket you receive by e‑mail shows the fare, taxes and any other charges. That ticket is considered your proof of payment and will be accepted as a receipt [S2]. All applicable taxes, fees and airport charges must be paid by you, and they are shown separately at the time of purchase [S1]. These amounts can change after the ticket is issued, and any increase must be paid, while any reduction may be refunded [S1].

Because the policy does not provide details on a cash‑later option or on specific documents to bring, you would need to contact Kenya Airways directly (e.g., via the contact centre or a ticketing office) for clarification on:

* whether cash payment at the airport can be used to settle a reservation made online, and any associated procedures;
* the exact items you must present at check‑in (e.g., passport, ticket receipt, possible card verification if the card was used for booking).  

If you decide to pay online now, be prepared to present the ticket (as proof of payment) and a valid ID at check‑in, and to pay any applicable taxes, fees or charges shown on the ticket [S1].

outcomes.question: Can I submit two different upgrade bids for the same flight? Card yangu itachargiwa lini?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza **kutoa tu Offer moja** kwa kila flight ambayo una tiketi ya Economy — hivyo hutaweza kutuma **bids mbili tofauti** kwa safari ileile. [S1]

Kadi yako itachukuliwa **mara tu Airline itakapokubali Offer yako**; atapo kukubali, kiasi ulichotoa (pamoja na ushuru unaotakiwa) kitaingia kwenye kadi yako. [S1]  

Kama Offer haijakubaliwa bado, unaweza **kubadilisha au kughairi** kiasi, lakini baada ya kukubaliwa hauwezi kujitoa tena. [S1]

outcomes.question: Ndege yangu ya kutoka Kisumu hadi Nairobi itaondoka saa nne na nusu asubuhi (10:30). Muda wa mwisho wa kaunta ni upi, na ninapaswa kuwa nimekamilisha kujisajili kufikia saa ngapi?
outcomes.final_response:
Mwandu wa nyumbani wa Kenya Airways unazingatia taratibu za “Domestic Check‑in”.  
Kwa safari ya ndani, unapaswa kukamilisha usajili angalau **saa 1.5 kabla ya kuondoka**. Hii inamaanisha kuwa, kwa ndege yako ya 10:30 asubuhi, usajili lazima uwe umekamilika **saa 9:00 asubuhi** [S1].  

Viti vya usajili (counters) hufungwa **dakika 30 kabla ya kuruka**, yani **saa 10:00 asubuhi** kwa safari hii [S1].

Kwa hiyo, hakikisha uko tayari kupita kwenye kaunta kabla ya 9:00 asubuhi, ili kuepuka usumbufu.

outcomes.question: My ticket is still valid but KQ cannot confirm a reservation when I ask. What options does the contract give me?
outcomes.final_response:
If you have a still‑valid ticket but Kenya Airways cannot confirm a reservation for you, the contract provides two possible remedies:

1. **Extension of ticket validity** – the airline will extend the ticket’s expiry date so you can travel later. [S2]

2. **Refund entitlement** – you may be eligible for a refund in line with the airline’s Article 10 refund rules. [S2]

outcomes.question: Ticket iko with KQ but partner airline ndio flies. Naweza book ile KQ extra legroom seat product?
outcomes.final_response:
Hapana, huwezi ku‑book extra legroom seat kwa safari inayofungwa na partner airline. Kama ilivyo imetajwa kwenye sera yetu, “extra Legroom Seats ... are offered only on Kenya Airways‑operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines” [S1].  

Kama usafiri wako unarushwa moja kwa moja na Kenya Airways, basi unaweza ku‑book nafasi hiyo (ikiwa inakidhi vigezo vya usalama na upatikanaji) – lakini kwa partner airline haina chaguo hilo.  

Kwa taarifa zaidi kuhusu vigezo vya kutosha (kama uwezo wa kufika na kufungua mlango wa dharura, umri wa miaka 18+, n.k.), tafadhali angalia sehemu ya “Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?” katika sera yetu. [S1]

outcomes.question: Nikikataa security scan ya baggage yangu, can KQ still allow me to board?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama utakataa security scan ya mizigo yako, Kenya Airways haitawezekana kukuwezesha boardi bila kuthibitisha kuna utimilifu wa usalama. Sijui sera maalum ya KQ kuhusu hali hii kwa sababu haina maelezo katika taarifa tulizo nazo. Kama unahitaji ufafanuzi wa kipekee au unataka kujua chaguzi zako, tafadhali **piga simu centre yetu ya mawasiliano** – ni njia pekee ya kupata msaada katika suala hili [S1]. 

Kwa hiyo, ushauri wa haraka ni kuwasiliana na **Contact Centre** ya Kenya Airways ili kujadili matokeo ya kukataa security scan na jinsi itakavyokimpacta nafasi yako ya boarding. Hapo ndipo utaweza kupata maelekezo sahihi na, iwapo inawezekana, suluhisho la hali yako.

outcomes.question: Ticket nilibuy kwa KQ ticketing office, si online. Refund na-arrange wapi?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa tiketi uliyonunua kutoka ofisi ya KQ (si‑online), refund inaweza kupangwa kwa njia zifuatazo:

* **Tembelea ofisi yoyote ya mauzo ya Kenya Airways** au **piga simu kwenye kituo cha mawasiliano** ili kupanga kughairi (cancellation) na kurudisha pesa. [S1]  
* Refund haitatolewa kwa barua pepe – lazima utumie mojawapo ya njia zilizo juu. [S1]  

Baada ya maombi yako ya refund, Kenya Airways hutoa kurejesha fedha ndani ya **siku za biashara 21‑30** (hata hivyo muda wa usindikaji wa benki yako unaweza kuchukua muda zaidi). [S1]  

Kumbuka, kiasi cha kurejeshwa kitatolewa kwa njia ile ile uliyolipa (kadi ya mkopo/kadi ya debit). [S1]  

Ikiwa unahitaji maelezo zaidi kuhusu ada za usimamizi (kama ada za kubadilisha/kughairi tiketi iliyonunuliwa kwenye ofisi ya uwanja wa ndege), ada hizi zinaanzia **USD 10‑100**. [S2]  

Kwa hiyo, chukua hatua ya kwenda ofisi ya mauzo au piga simu kwa kituo cha mawasiliano cha Kenya Airways ili kuanzisha refund yako.

outcomes.question: Nipo Uholanzi na nataka kulipa tiketi kupitia iDEAL. Mchakato wake unafanyikaje?
outcomes.final_response:
iDEAL ni njia ya malipo ya mtandaoni inayotegemea benki, inayotumika na watumiaji nchini Uholanzi. Unapofanya ununuzi mtandaoni, fuata hatua hizi:

1. **Chagua iDEAL** kama njia ya malipo.  
2. **Utaelekezwa** kwa mazingira ya huduma ya benki ya mtumiaji (banki yako ya mtandaoni).  
3. **Ingia** katika akaunti yako ya benki, kisha thibitisha malipo.  
4. **Malipo yanashughulikiwa papo hapo**, na baada ya Kenya Airways kupokea uthibitisho wa malipo, utapoke barua pepe yenye tiketi ya kielektroniki na uthibitisho wa malipo. [S1]

outcomes.question: I had already checked my bags before rebooking a disrupted flight. Do I need to collect and check them in again?
outcomes.final_response: No – if you had already checked your bags before you re‑booked, the airline will automatically transfer them to your new flight. You do not need to collect and re‑check them. [S1]

outcomes.question: Ticket ni ya KQ lakini partner airline ndio operates flight. Whose rules apply kwa boarding na refunds?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa ticket ya Kenya Airways (KQ) lakini ndege inarukuliwa na partner airline, sheria za “fare” za KQ bado ndizo zitakazoendelea kutumika. Hii ina maana kwamba masharti ya kughairi, ada za kubadilisha, na haki za marejesho ya fedha yanabaki yale yaliyo kwenye tiketi yako ya awali – hata kama ukapata upgrade au ndege inachukuliwa na kampuni nyingine [S1].  

**Refunds**  
Marejesho ya fedha yatashughulikiwa kulingana na masharti ya tiketi ya KQ. Kwa tiketi zilizonunuliwa moja kwa moja kupitia Kenya‑Airways.com, refund itaombwa kupitia njia zilizo kwenye “Refund widget” au fomu ya refund, na KQ itatoa pesa kwenye njia ya malipo iliyotumika – kwa muda wa biashara wa siku 21‑30, isipokuwa muda wa usindikaji wa benki yako [S2].  Tiketi zilizotonyezwa kupitia mawakala wa safari hazina uwezo wa kurejesha moja kwa moja; unapaswa kuwasiliana na wakala huyo [S2].

**Boarding**  
Sheria za boardi kawaida hutimwa na kampuni inayotoa huduma (the operating carrier). Katika ushahidi uliotolewa hakuna taarifa maalum juu ya sheria za boardi za partner airline, kwa hivyo hatuwezi kuthibitisha ni sheria gani zitumika. Ili kupata maelezo kamili, tembelea tovuti ya partner airline au wasiliane na kituo cha huduma kwa wateja cha KQ.

Kwa kifupi: masharti ya refund yanatokana na KQ (S1, S2), lakini sheria za boardi zinategemea kampuni inayopaa ndege, ambazo hazijatajwa katika ushahidi uliopewa.

outcomes.question: Je, nitalazimika kujaza fomu hiyo kabla ya safari?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, unahitaji kujaza fomu kulingana na sababu unayohitaji fomu hiyo:

* **Kama ni fomu ya rufaa ya muda wa kuchelewa (zaidi ya saa 8)** – inapaswa kujazwa baada ya kuchelewa kwa muda huo. Baada ya kuwasilisha fomu, usafiri wako wote utaongolewa. [S1]

* **Kama ni fomu ya matibabu (MEDIF) kwa mahitaji ya kiusalama au kifua** – lazima uijaze kamili na uiwasilishe kwa angalau masaa 24 kabla ya safari ili kupokea kibali cha kusafiri. [S2]

outcomes.question: Nimeshindwa kusafiri kwa sababu za matibabu. Je, nina haki ya kurejeshewa pesa zote au kubadilisha tarehe bila malipo moja kwa moja?
outcomes.final_response:
Hali ya kukataliwa kusafiri kwa sababu za matibabu **haipewi kurejeshewa pesa kamili, wala hakutolewa mabadiliko ya tarehe bila malipo**. Kama ilivyo katika sera yetu, **kwa sababu za kiafya hakuna kurejesha fedha wala kubadilisha bila ada – lazima utegemee masharti ya tiketi yako** ([S1]).

Iwapo unashikilia tiketi isiyorejeshwa (non‑refundable), unaweza **kurekebisha tarehe ya safari ndani ya mwaka mmoja tangu tarehe ya kutolewa kwa tiketi, lakini atakuwa na ada ya mabadiliko inayoambatana nayo** ([S1]).

Kwa muhtasari:  
- **Hakuna kurejesha pesa** kwa sababu ya matibabu.  
- **Hakuna mabadiliko ya bure**; changamoto itategemea masharti ya tiketi na ada husika.  
- Ikiwa tiketi yako ni “non‑refundable”, unaweza kurekebisha tarehe bila kupoteza thamani kamili ya tiketi, lakini ada ya mabadiliko itachukuliwa.

Kama unahitaji kuwasilisha fomu ya ombi la kurejesha (ambayo itaghairi uhifadhi wako) tafadhali tembelea ukurasa wa “request for your refund” kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways. ([S1])

outcomes.question: Suitcase yangu ilikuwa heavy na expensive. Does KQ calculate baggage compensation using weight or value, na insurance inasaidiaje?
outcomes.final_response:
KQ hajihesabi fidia ya mizigo kwa kulingana na uzito wala bei ya mzigo, bali inategemea viwango vya mamlaka ya shirika na makubaliano ya usafiri. [S1]  

**Mlinganisho wa viwango**  
- KQ inakataa kuwajibika kulingana na uzito au thamani ya mzigo. [S1]  
- Hata hivyo, kulingana na Mkataba wa Warsaw, wapi unatumika, kipimo cha fidia kinaweza kuwa 17 Special Drawing Rights (SDR) kwa kila kilo ya mizigo iliyokaguliwa. [S2]  

**Kiasi cha fidia (kwa kawaida)**  
| Daraja la tiketi | Kiasi cha fidia (USD) |
|------------------|----------------------|
| First Class & Premier World | 150 USD |
| Economy | 100 USD |
| Watoto 2‑12 y (50 % ya kipengele cha daraja) | — |
| Watoto < 2 y | Hakuna First Needs Allowance |

*Vigezo hivi vinaweza kubadilika kulingana na sheria za nchi, tiketi ya tuzo, au wafanyakazi wa KQ.* [S1]  

**Jinsi bima inavyosaidia**  
- Unaweza kutangaza thamani ya juu ya mzigo na kulipa ada ya ziada ili kupanua ubora wa fidia. [S1]  
- KQ inashauri sana abiria wapate bima ya safari kabla ya kusafiri; bima itaweza kulipia hasara zaidi ya viwango vya KQ. [S1]  
- Kwa kuamua kiwango kikubwa cha uwajibikaji, anafaa kuwasiliana na **KQ Insurance**. [S1]  

Kwa muhtasari, KQ haitoi fidia kulingana na uzito au thamani ya mizigo, lakini kuna viwango vya msingi (USD 150/100 kulingana na daraja) na uwezekano wa kuongeza kiasi kwa kutangaza thamani ya juu na kulipa ada. Bima ya safari inashauriwa ili kulinda mali yako ya thamani juu ya viwango hivyo. [S1][S2]

outcomes.question: I had a confirmed seat but KQ couldn't provide space. What conditions and possible forms of compensation does the contract mention?
outcomes.final_response:
If a confirmed seat cannot be provided, the contract treats this as **denied boarding**.

**Conditions**  
- Compensation is only payable when the passenger has complied with all check‑in and boarding deadlines. [S2]

**Possible forms of compensation**  
- **Monetary reimbursement** (cash or equivalent).  
- **Alternate transportation** on another carrier at no additional charge.  
- **Downgrade refund** (refund of the difference if the passenger is placed in a lower‑class cabin). [S2]

These remedies are provided in accordance with the applicable law and Kenya Airways’ denied‑boarding compensation policy. [S2]

outcomes.question: Will I be charged for the change?
outcomes.final_response:
You will not be charged when you use Kenya Airways’ self‑rebooking tool for a disrupted flight — the tool is provided free of charge【S2】.  

If the change you are considering involves an already‑accepted upgrade offer, the airline does not allow refunds, credits, exchanges or transfers once the offer has been paid for, except in the specific situations listed (e.g., the upgraded flight is cancelled or you are re‑accommodated in economy because of reasons attributable to the airline)【S1】. In those exceptional cases, a refund of the upgrade amount may be processed back to the credit card used for payment【S1】.  

So:

* **Disrupted‑flight rebooking:** no fee.  
* **Changing an accepted upgrade offer:** generally no fee or refund, unless one of the outlined airline‑initiated circumstances applies.

outcomes.question: Niko Nigeria na sitaki kutumia card. Can I use bank transfer and which digital banking channels are listed?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza kutumia **bank transfer** bila kutumia kadi yako, kwani hii ni mojawapo ya “Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)” inayopatikana nchini **Nigeria** pamoja na Kenya na nchi chache za Afrika. It works as a real‑time 24‑hour digital payment solution that you can do via online banking, mobile apps, au USSD mobile banking [S1].

**Digital banking channels zilizoorodheshwa**:

| Channel | Maelezo |
|---------|---------|
| **Mobile Banking / Bank Transfer** | Inapatikana kupitia online banking, apps za simu, na USSD; ni haraka, salama, na gharama nafuu [S1] |
| **Equitel** | Mobile payment kutoka Kenya [S1] |
| **Vodacom Mpesa** | Mobile money service ya Tanzania [S1] |
| **MTN Mobile Money** | Wallet ya mobile money, inaweza kutumika kulipia tiketi [S1] |
| **Tigo Pesa** | Mobile money service ya Tanzania [S1] |
| **Mpesa** | Mobile money kutoka Kenya na Tanzania [S1] |
| **Airtel Money** | Mobile money inayopatikana Kenya, Tanzania na nchi nyingine [S1] |

Baada ya malipo kukamilika, tiketi yako itatumwa kwa barua pepe [S1].

outcomes.question: Can I arrange higher baggage liability coverage by declaring a higher value before I travel?
outcomes.final_response:
Yes. Kenya Airways will increase its liability for loss, delay or damage to your checked baggage only if you **declare a higher value in advance and pay the applicable surcharge** [S1][S2].  

When you make that declaration, the amount you pay is deducted from any final compensation you might receive, and the total paid must not exceed the airline’s maximum liability (you would need to contact KQ Insurance to confirm that ceiling) [S1].  

If you do not declare a higher value, the standard limits apply:

| Cabin class | Maximum liability per passenger |
|-------------|---------------------------------|
| First class / Premier World | USD 150 |
| Economy class | USD 100 |
| Children 2‑12 yr (Economy/Business) | 50 % of the applicable limit |
| Children < 2 yr | No First Needs Allowance |

These limits are the ceiling even when a higher value is declared [S1].  

Note that Kenya Airways does **not** accept liability for fragile, perishable, or high‑value items such as jewellery, money, electronics, etc., even if you declare a higher value; you are advised to keep such valuables with you or obtain separate travel insurance [S1][S2].

outcomes.question: What happens if I leave my suitcase uncollected at the airport for four months?
outcomes.final_response: I’m sorry, but the information you’re asking about isn’t covered in the policies I have access to. For details on what happens to uncollected baggage after an extended period, please contact Kenya Airways Customer Service or the airport’s lost‑and‑found department directly. They’ll be able to give you the specific procedures and any applicable fees.

outcomes.question: Nataka pack hairspray na perfume. According to restrictions, limits za checked aerosols ni gani?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza pakia hairspray na perfume katika checked baggage, lakini :

- Kila kipande cha aerosol (hair spray, perfume, dawa zenye alcohol) hakiwezi kupita **0.5 kg/L** per article.  
- Jumla ya uzito wa aerosols zote katika bag yako haipaswi kuzidi **2.0 kg/L**.  

Hii ni kisheria kwa checked baggage kwa Kenya Airways [S1].

outcomes.question: Niambie exact compensation amount that the insurer approved for my claim today.
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, lakini **maelezo ya kiasi halisi cha fidia kilichokubaliwa na bima kwa dai lako ya leo hayako katika makala ya sera tuliyo nayo**. Polisi inataja kwamba, kama ni suala la kifo, **malipo ya awali hayapaswi kupungua na 16 000 SDR kwa abiria**【S1】, na kwamba kiasi cha fidia kinatengenezwa kulingana na hali maalum ya kila dai【S1】. 

Kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa taarifa maalum kwenye sera, siwezi kukupa kiasi halisi kilichothibitishwa. Ili kupata maelezo sahihi, tafadhali wasiliana moja kwa moja na bima yako au huduma ya wateja ya Kenya Airways, ambapo wataweza kukusaidia kwa taarifa za kipekee za akaunti yako. 

Ikiwa una maswali mengine kuhusu mchakato wa madai, muda wa kukiweka, au masharti ya fidia, nitafurahi kukusaidia.

outcomes.question: How can I request my money back, and what happens to the rest of the booking?

fixed_history.content: I booked directly on the Kenya Airways website. My flight was delayed by nine hours and I decided not to travel.
What assistance do you need with the booking?

outcomes.final_response:
You can ask for a refund through the **Manage Booking** section on the Kenya Airways website. After logging in, choose the “Request for refund” option that appears in the list of actions you can take on your reservation [S2]. If you encounter any problem with the payment or need help with the request, you can also contact the Customer Service Support section on the website for real‑time assistance [S2].

Because your flight was delayed (a schedule change), the self‑service re‑booking tool is available [S1]. If you do not select a new flight yourself, the system will automatically place you on the next available flight and send you an email with the new details [S1]. Declining the automatic change will route you to the Customer Excellence Centre, where you can arrange a refund or a different re‑booking [S1].

So, to get your money back:

1. Log in to **Manage Booking** → “Request for refund”.  
2. Follow the prompts, or if you need further help, use the Customer Service Support chat/phone.

If you do not take any action, the booking will be automatically re‑booked on the next available flight [S1]; otherwise, cancelling the delayed segment will leave the rest of the itinerary unchanged unless you also choose to cancel those flights.  

*Note: the policy details provided do not specify a separate refund entitlement for a delayed flight, so the refund request must be submitted through the steps above or by contacting customer support.*

outcomes.question: Outbound flight yangu imechange, return iko sawa. Can I change the return for free through self-rebooking?
outcomes.final_response:
Hakuna tatizo, lakini **self‑rebooking** inapatikana **tu kwa safari ambazo zimepoteza au kubadilishwa**. Kwa sababu outbound yako imechange na return yako haijabadilishwa, hutaweza kuitumia huduma hii kubadilisha return bila malipo.  

- “Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted? No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self‑rebooking.” [S1]  
- “If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge? No. … you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact centre office.” [S1]  

Kwa hiyo, ikiwa unataka kubadilisha return, tafadhali wasiliane na **travel agent** yako au **Kenya Airways Contact Centre**. Hapa ndipo utakapata msaada wa kurekebisha safari ya kurudi bila malipo, lakini si kupitia self‑rebooking.  

Kumbuka, **ukitumia self‑rebooking kwa safari iliyo disrupted, haitakuwa na ada** [S1], lakini kwa return yako ambayo haijabadilika, chaguo la moja kwa moja halipo.  

**Hatua unazoweza kuchukua**  
1. Piga simu +254 711 024 747 au tembelea “Contact Centre” kwenye tovuti.  
2. Mwulize kuhusu mabadiliko ya return na utafute suluhisho bila malipo.  

Natumai taarifa hii imekusaidia! 🚀

outcomes.question: Nilitumia first leg, KQ ikacancel rest. Involuntary refund inacalculatiwa aje?
outcomes.final_response:
Ukiulizwa “involuntary refund” baada ya Kenya Airways kukataa sehemu ya pili ya safari yako, kifedha kinarejelewa kulingana na masharti ya tiketi uliyonunua.

- **Kiasi kinachorejeshwa** – Kwa tiketi zisizorejesha (non‑refundable ticket) Kenya Airways itarejesha **mapato ya kodi, ada na gharama nyingine zinazohusiana na tiketi** pekee. Hii imewekwa kwenye sera ya tiketi – “they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees” [S1].  
- **Ada au penaliti** – Kiasi hicho kinaweza kupunguzwa na **ada au penaliti zinazotokana na masharti ya tiketi**; “All Refund Requests are subject to the rules of the ticketed fare, and fees or penalties may apply to your Refund” [S1].  
- **Muda wa kurejeshwa** – Kiasi kitakutumwa kwenye njia ile ile uliotumia kulipia (kadi ya mkopo/kadi ya debit) na **hata siku 21‑30 za biashara** itakamilika, isipokuwa muda wa usindikaji wa benki yako [S1].  
- **Jinsi ya kuomba** – Kwa usafiri uliogombolewa, lazima ujaze **fomu ya Refund** (link iliyotolewa kwenye portal ya Kenya Airways) na ukamilishe usajili; baada ya kutuma, **booking yako itachukuliwa kuwa imeghairiwa kabisa** [S1].

Kwa muhtasari, refund ya “involuntary” itahesabiwa kwa kurejesha kodi, ada na gharama (kama zinapatikana), baada ya kupunguza ada/penalti kulingana na masharti ya tiketi, na itatuma kwenye njia ya malipo ulivyotumia ndani ya kipindi cha siku 21‑30 za biashara. Ikiwa ulinunua kupitia wakala wa usafiri, unahitaji kuwasiliana nao moja kwa moja kwa ushauri wa kurejesha.

outcomes.question: Can I claim hiyo amount back?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, unaweza kudai kurejeshwa kiasi hicho, lakini lazima ukidhi masharti yaliyotajwa.

- **Sababu ya kurejesha**: Refund inaruhusiwa ikiwa tatizo lilitokana na shirika (kwa mfano, usafiri wa ndege ubadilika, kuchelewa kwa uunganisho uliokusababisha kupoteza upgrade). Hii **haihusishi makosa yako**. [S1]

- **Muda wa kudai**: Ombi la refund lazima liwasilishwe **katika miezi mitatu (3) baada ya safari kutokea**. [S1]

- **Nyang’ao zinazohitajika**:  
  1. Tiketi ya daraja la biashara (business class) au boarding pass ya safari husika.  
  2. Nakala ya barua pepe iliyoonyesha kwamba ulipata upgrade. [S1]

- **Jinsi refund inavyofanywa**:  
  - Kiasi kilicholipwa cha upgrade kitatolewa kwenye **kadi ya mkopo** ambayo ulitumia kulipa. [S1]  
  - Refund itatengenezwa kwa **sarafu ile ile** ambayo ilitumika kulipa upgrade, na kiwango cha ubadilishaji cha fedha kinachokubalika kita tumika; hatutakuwa na kiasi kilichozidi kile kilicholipwa, na malipo ya benki hayarejeshwi. [S1]  
  - Muda wa kukamilika ni **siku kumi (10) za kazi**. [S1]

Kama unataka kudai, hakikisha una nakala za nyaraka zilizo kwenye orodha ya juu, kisha tembelea ukurasa wa *Online Refunds* wa Kenya Airways ili kujaza fomu husika. [S2]  

Ukikubaliana na masharti haya, ombi lako linaweza kupitiwa. [S1]

outcomes.question: Can I use that document as proof of payment for my employer?

fixed_history.content: I paid for my KQ flight and received an electronic ticket by email.
What do you need for your records?

outcomes.final_response: Yes. The e‑ticket you received shows the fare and taxes paid for your flight, and it is considered your proof of payment. It is widely accepted as a receipt, so you can provide it to your employer as evidence of the payment. [S1]

outcomes.question: Msimbo wangu wa punguzo haukubaliki kwenye tovuti ya KQ. Ninawezaje kutoa taarifa kuhusu tatizo hilo?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama msimbo wako wa punguzo haukubaliki kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways, tumia alama ya **feedback** iliyo kwenye upande wa kulia wa dirisha la kivinjari wako ili kuripoti tatizo hilo. [S1]

Unaweza pia kufungua kipengele cha **Customer Service Support** kwenye tovuti ili kupata maoni ya papo hapo, au piga simu kwenye **Global Contact Center** kwa msaada zaidi.  

Kumbuka kuandika maelezo kamili ya msimbo, tarehe ya matumizi, na aina ya tiketi ili timu ya msaada ipate taarifa ya kutosha.  

Ikiwa tatizo litaendelea, tutakupa mwongozo wa ziada baada ya uchunguzi wa timu yetu. [S1]

outcomes.question: Booking yangu imehamishwa to another airline after paying for upgrade. Will the upgrade transfer or pesa itarudi aje?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama usafiri wako umeregelewa kwa ndege nyingine baada ya kulipa upgrade, **upgrade haitahamishwi** kwa kurudiwa kwenye daraja la juu. Kwa mujibu wa masharti yetu, “In the event your booking is transferred to a flight operated by another airline, we cannot guarantee an Upgrade to the higher class. In this case any amounts that you paid for the Upgrade will be refunded to the credit card that was used to pay for the Upgrade” [S1].

Hivyo, pesa utakazopata re‑fund itarudi kwenye kadi ya mkopo uliyotumia kulipa upgrade. Refund kawaida hudumu takriban **siku kumi za kazi** ili ionekane kwenye akaunti yako, na hatutarejeshi ada za benki [S1].

Kumbuka kwamba upgrade **haiwezi kuhamishwa** au kupelekwa kwa mtu mwingine, wala kwa ndege nyingine, kulingana na “An Upgrade that has been issued by the Airline cannot be assigned or transferred, in whole or in part to another person or flight” [S1].

Kwa maelezo zaidi au usaidizi wa ufuatiliaji wa refund, tafadhali wasiliana na ofisi ya Kenya Airways au wakala wako wa safari.

outcomes.question: The flight has been changed a second time. Can I use it again?

fixed_history.content: Earlier KQ changed my flight and I already used the disruption self-rebooking tool.
I understand. What has happened since then?

outcomes.final_response:
Yes—you can re‑book again. The self‑rebooking tool may be used **once for each disruption**, so a second schedule change gives you another opportunity to choose a new flight at no charge [S1].

To do this:

1. Visit the Kenya Airways website and select **“Manage Booking.”**  
2. Click the re‑booking link at the top (“Click here”).  
3. Review the available flight options (only flights ≤ 24 hours before or ≥ 7 days after the original time) and select the one that suits you.  
4. Confirm the new flight – there are no additional fees [S1].

If you are unable to re‑book yourself, the system will automatically place you on the next available flight and email you the details [S1].  

Should you need any assistance, the Customer Support team is reachable via the website or at +254 711 024 747.

outcomes.question: My bags are delayed and I am buying toiletries and other items. What proof is required and what can be reimbursed?
outcomes.final_response:
For a delayed‑baggage claim you must submit a written request within 7 days of arriving at the nearest Kenya Airways office (or contact your insurance company) and include the reference you received when you reported the delay [S1]. Attach the original receipts for every essential item you purchased [S1] and quote the baggage‑delay reference on the claim [S1]. The claim is processed against a signed First‑Need Expenses Form (Release) [S1].

**Reimbursement – what you can be paid**

- Only essential items (toiletries, first‑needs items) are eligible [S1].  
- Limits per passenger:  
  • USD 150 for First Class and Premier World [S1]  
  • USD 100 for Economy Class [S1]  
- Children 2‑12 years receive 50 % of the applicable class limit [S1]; children under 2 receive no allowance [S1].  
- Passengers who have already received at least one bag may not be entitled to the allowance [S1].

Make sure the claim is filed in writing, includes the reference number, and is supported by itemised receipts; reimbursement will be limited to the amounts above for the class and age of the passenger.

outcomes.question: Ninasafiri na mtoto wangu wa mwaka mmoja. Je, ninaweza kutoa zabuni ya kupandishwa daraja la biashara?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, unaweza kutoa zabuni ya kupandishwa daraja la Biusiness Class kwa nafasi ya kusafiri na mtoto wako wa mwaka mmoja, ikiwa umetiwa tiketi halali ya Daraja la Kiuchumi la Kenya Airways kwa nyumba ya‑safari iliyopangwa.  

- **Uhitaji wa tiketi halali** – Ili kutuma “Smart Upgrade” unahitaji tiketi iliyo tolewa na iliyethibitishwa kwa daraja la kiuchumi la flight iliyopangwa na KQ. Unaweza kutoa zabuni hadi masaa 14 kabla ya kuondoka. [S1]  

- **Watoto ndani ya usanifu mmoja** – Upgrades inazingatia watoto nyote ndani ya booking moja, hivyo unaweza kujumuisha mtoto wa mwaka mmoja kama alipo na tiketi ya infant. [S1]  

Kama unataka kuwasilisha zabuni, tembelea kiungo cha “Upgrade Flight” kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways, jaza taarifa za usafiri, na uanze ofa yako. Unaweza kubadilisha kiasi cha ofa kabla ya kupokea barua pepe ya uthibitisho. [S1]  

Kumbuka, baada ofa yako ikubaliwa, kiasi kilicholipwa hakiwezi kurejeshwa. [S1]

outcomes.question: I'm an Asante Silver member travelling in Economy. What extra checked baggage do I get?
outcomes.final_response: As an Asante Silver member flying in Economy you receive **one extra checked‑baggage piece**. The additional piece follows the Economy‑class weight limit of **23 kg**. [S1]

outcomes.question: For a flight from Mombasa to Nairobi, what identification and airport check-in deadlines apply?
outcomes.final_response:
For a domestic Kenya Airways flight such as Mombasa → Nairobi, you must:

* **Present a valid form of identification** at the check‑in counter. [S1]  
* **Complete the check‑in process at least 1 ½ hours before the scheduled departure**. [S1]  
* **Check‑in counters close 30 minutes before take‑off**; after that you will not be able to check in at the airport. [S1]  

You can also use online check‑in (available from 48 hours up to 1 hour before departure) and still need to be at the airport in time for the 1 ½‑hour deadline. [S1]

outcomes.question: Niko na Amex card, si Visa. Which card brands does KQ accept for online payment?
outcomes.final_response: KQ inakubali kadi za **Visa**, **MasterCard** na **American Express (Amex)** kwa malipo ya mtandaoni [S1] [S1] [S1].

outcomes.question: Nikipokea posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza halafu begi langu likapotea kabisa, posho ile itaathiri fidia ya mwisho?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama umepokea malipo ya awali (kama “posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza”) baada ya kukosa bagi lako, malipo haya hayajui kuwa ni uamuzi wa hatima ya madai yako. Kampuni itachukua kiasi kilicholipwa awali na kukikata kutoka kwenye fidia ya mwisho itakayotolewa. Hii inaelezwa katika sera ya fidia, ambapo “malipo ya awali hayajui kama kutambua uwajibikaji na yanaweza kupunguzwa kutoka kwenye kiasi kingine chochote kilicholipwa kwa msingi wa uwajibikaji” [S2].

Kwa hiyo, fidia ya mwisho itakuwa ni kiasi cha jumla kinachostahiki kimepunguzwa na kiasi ulichopewa awali. Ikiwa ubatili wa msafiri ubebea jukumu kwa upande wako, kampuni inaweza kupunguzwa au kuwa haina uwajibikaji, kulingana na masharti yanayofuatana na sheria husika [S2].

outcomes.question: Tuko abiria kumi kwenye nafasi moja. Je, tunaweza kubadilisha tiketi zetu kupitia tovuti?
outcomes.final_response: Hapana, huwezi kubadilisha tiketi za kundi la abiria kumi kupitia tovuti. Kiwango cha juu cha abiria ambao unaweza kubadilishwa kwa njia ya mtandaoni ni 9; kundi la zaidi ya hili linahitaji uwasiliano na kituo cha Mawasiliano cha Kenya Airways. [S1]

outcomes.question: Mtoto wangu wa miaka minane anastahiki posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza baada ya mizigo kuchelewa katika daraja la uchumi. Kiwango chake cha juu ni kiasi gani?
outcomes.final_response: Mtoto wako mwenye umri wa miaka 8 anastahiki 50 % ya kiwango cha kawaida cha Economy, ambayo ni **USD 50** kwa ajili ya First Needs Allowance. [S2]

outcomes.question: I missed my flight without cancelling. Can I change my reservation through the website now?
outcomes.final_response:
You missed the flight, but it was not a schedule‑change (delay or cancellation) made by Kenya Airways. The self‑rebooking tool on the website is only available for disrupted flights — those that the airline has delayed or canceled — and cannot be used for a flight you simply missed 【S1】.  

Therefore you cannot change or rebook the reservation through the “Manage Booking” self‑service page at this time. To re‑book you’ll need to contact Kenya Airways’ Customer Excellence Centre (or your travel‑agent, if the ticket was booked through one) for assistance.

outcomes.question: Nikiingia kwenye tovuti ya kujipangia ndege nyingine, ni taarifa zipi niandike ili kufungua nafasi yangu?
outcomes.final_response:
Ili ufungue nafasi ya kujipangia ndege nyingine kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways, unahitaji:

* **Nambari ya uhifadhi (booking reference) au nambari ya tiketi ya kielektroniki (e‑ticket number).** Hii ndilo taarifa pekee inayohitajika kwa ajili ya kujipangia mwenyewe [S1].

**Hatua za kufuata**

1. Tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways (https://www.kenya‑airways.com/en‑ke/).  
2. Chagua **“Manage Booking”**.  
3. Bonyeza kiungo cha **“Click here”** kilicho juu ili kuingia kwenye sehemu ya kujipangia.  
4. Ingiza nambari yako ya uhifadhi au e‑ticket, kisha utaona machaguo ya ndege na nyakati zinazopatikana [S1].

Baada ya kuchagua na kuthibitisha safari mpya, barua pepe itakuletea tiketi ya kielektroniki na pasipoti ya mabwawa [S1].  

Usisahau kwamba huduma hii inapatikana kwa safari zilizobadilishwa (imechelewa au kumeghairiwa) na haitachukulia malipo yoyote [S1].

outcomes.question: Nataka kusafiri na paka wangu wa nyumbani. Je, ninaweza kumpakia kama mzigo wa kawaida au kumbeba ndani ya ndege?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, paka wako unaweza kusafiri, lakini siwezi kuwekewa kwenye nafasi ya mzigo wa bure kama “baggage ya kawaida”. Kenya Airways inakubali kupeleka wanyama tu ikiwa:

* **Paka amewekwa kwenye sanduku la usalama (crate) linalokidhi mahitaji ya sheria** na ana nyaraka sahihi – cheti cha afya, cheti cha chanjo, vibali vya kuingia/kuondoka, na nyaraka zozote zinazohitajika kwa nchi ya kuingia au kutembea kupitia.  [S1] 8.9.1  
* **Kama wanyama wanakubaliwa, sanduku lake pamoja na chakula kitachukuliwa kama mzigo wa ziada** (excess baggage) na utalipwa ada husika. [S1] 8.9.2  

Kampuni ina haki ya kukataa kabisa usafirishaji wa wanyama kwa hiari yake.  [S1] 8.9  

Kumbuka, **mbwa wa mwongozo kwa abiria wenye ulemavu** wanachukuliwa bure na hayajumuishi kwenye mzigo wa bure, lakini hii haitahusiana na paka. [S1] 8.9.3  

Kwa hivyo, paka wako hatupaswi kujaribu kuwekea ndani ya kaburi la abiria au kujumuishwa katika mzigo wako wa bure. Ni lazima uandike kama mzigo wa ziada, uwe na sanduku linalofaa, na ulethe nyaraka zote zinazohitajika kabla ya safari. Ikiwa unahitaji maelezo zaidi kuhusu ada za mzigo wa ziada au mahitaji maalum ya sanduku, unaweza kuwasiliana na kituo chetu cha huduma kwa wateja.

outcomes.question: Does my trained service dog need a cage in the cabin, and can it sit beside me on a seat?
outcomes.final_response:
No cage is required. A certified service dog may travel in the cabin as long as it is **properly harnessed** and **does not occupy a seat**【S1】.  

The dog must be positioned **at the feet of your seat** (or, if the seat next to you is empty, at the feet/floor of that adjacent seat) and must not block the aisle【S1】.  

Therefore, the dog cannot sit on a seat beside you, but it can be on the floor beside your seat, provided the adjacent seat is unoccupied.  

(You will need to provide the required medical documentation and make an advanced reservation as described in the service‑dog policy.)

outcomes.question: What is the exact exchange rate my bank will apply to a card payment this afternoon?
outcomes.final_response: Kenya Airways does not set the exchange rate for a card payment. If you pay in a currency different from the one shown on the booking page, the rate is applied by your financial institution, and any additional charges are also determined by them. Please check directly with your bank for the exact rate that will be used for today’s transaction. [S1]

outcomes.question: Je, ni kiasi gani haswa cha fedha nitakacholipwa kwa fidia ya begi langu baada ya uchunguzi kukamilika?
outcomes.final_response:
Hakuna taarifa katika vyanzo vilivyotolewa kuhusu kiasi maalum cha fidia ya begi baada ya uchunguzi kukamilika. Polisi ya Kenya Airways haijatangaza kiwango kilichowekwa cha malipo kwa fidia ya bagaji, hivyo hatuwezi kutoa nambari ya kiasi cha fedha utakachopokea. 

Ili kupata maelezo sahihi na ya kina, tunakushauri uwasiliane moja kwa moja na huduma kwa wateja wa Kenya Airways au tembelea sehemu ya **Baggage Compensation** kwenye tovuti yao. 

*(Hakuna ushahidi unaohusu kiwango cha fidia ya begi katika S1 au S2.)*

outcomes.question: If my suitcase is sent on a different aircraft and customs needs me present, will KQ deliver it without me?
outcomes.final_response:
If your checked suitcase is placed on a later flight, Kenya Airways will normally bring it to you once it arrives — but only if the law of the destination does not require your presence for customs clearance. When local regulations do demand that the passenger be present to clear the bag, the airline cannot deliver it without you. [S1][S2]

Delivery is also limited to the person who holds the baggage claim ticket and the baggage‑identification tag. [S1][S2]

outcomes.question: Nina ala ya muziki dhaifu ambayo haifai kuwekwa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo na ni kubwa kuliko kiwango cha kawaida cha kabatini. Je, ninaweza kuibeba ndani ya ndege?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza kuleta kifaa hicho cha muziki kwenye ndege, lakini kwa kuwa ni kifaa kilicho dhaifu na kikubwa zaidi ya kipimo cha kawaida cha mizigo ya kabati, kinahitajika kutendeka kama **mizigo maalum**.

- Mizigo ya kabati lazima iambatanishe lebo ya “approved KQ cabin luggage” na iwe na vipimo visivyo zaidi ya **L55 × W25 × H35 cm** (au viwango vidogo zaidi kwa vifaa vya kibinafsi) [S1].  
- Vifaa kama nyuzi za muziki nyeti au vifaa vingine vya thamani/nyeti haviruhusiwi kutakwa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo ya mizigo ya mizigo (cargo) bila ruhusa maalum [S2].  
- Kwa kifaa hicho, Kenya Airways inahitaji **taarifa ya awali** na **idhini** kabla ya safari; gharama ya ziada inaweza kutolewa [S2].  
- Ukikataa kurekodi kifaa hicho kama mizigo maalum, itabidi **ikubwekee kwenye mizigo ya kutakiwa (checked baggage)**, ikifuatwa na ada ya ziada ya mizigo (kama inavyobidiwa) [S2].

**Hatua unazopaswa kuchukua**

1. Wasiliana na Kenya Airways mapema (kupitia mtandao, simu au kituo cha huduma) na uombe **kukuza kifaa cha muziki kama “special baggage.”**  
2. Toa maelezo kamili ya kipimo, uzito, na ubora wa kifaa.  
3. Jifunze ada za ziada zinazoweza kutumika kwa kifaa hicho.  
4. Pakua kifaa kwa usalama ili kizuie usumbufu wakati wa usafirishaji.  

Ikiwa idhini haijatolewa au kipimo kinavuka sana viwango vya kabati, kifaa kitapandwa kwenye mizigo ya kutakiwa (checked baggage) na kulipwa ada ya ziada. Kwa habari zaidi, tembelea tovuti ya “Special Baggage” ya Kenya Airways.

outcomes.question: Nitasafiri kutoka Nairobi hadi New York. Kujisajili mtandaoni kunaanza na kumalizika muda gani kabla ya safari?
outcomes.final_response:
Kujisajili mtandaoni kwa safari yako ya Nairobi → New York (ndege ya kimataifa inayohusisha Marekani) kunafunguliwa **saa 24 kabla ya muda uliopangwa wa kutokea** na kunapatikana mpaka **saa 1 kabla ya kuruka**.  

Pia, ili kukamilisha taratibu za kiini, lazima ufanyie ukaguzi wa mizigo (check‑in) **angalau saa 2.5 kabla ya kutokea**, kwani madarasa ya ukaguzi hufungwa saa 1 kabla ya kutokea. [S1]

outcomes.question: I booked using miles and KQ cancelled my flight. Is the disruption self-rebooking tool available for award tickets?
outcomes.final_response:
Yes. The Kenya Airways self‑rebooking tool works for award (miles‑redeemed) tickets as well as for regular tickets. When a flight you booked with miles is cancelled, you can log in to **Manage Booking** on the Kenya Airways website and use the self‑rebooking link to select a new flight at no extra charge【S1】.  

- The tool is only available for flights that have been disrupted (canceled or rescheduled).  
- You will not be charged for using it【S1】.  
- After you confirm the new flight you will receive an e‑ticket and boarding‑pass via email【S1】.  

If you encounter any issues or need assistance beyond the self‑service options, you can contact the Kenya Airways Customer Excellence Centre or your travel agent.

outcomes.question: Nilitumia miles kubook, KQ ikacancel flight. Award ticket inaweza self-rebook kupitia disruption tool?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, award ticket yako iliyotengenezwa kwa miles inaweza ku‑self‑rebook kupitia disruption tool.  

- Zana hii inafanya re‑booking ya award tickets – “Does the tool rebook award tickets? Yes, it does” [S1].  
- Kuhifadhi malengo yako ya usafiri, chagua **Manage Booking** kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways, kisha bofya kiungo *Click here* ili kuona chaguzi za ndege zilizopo. Hii ni kwa ajili ya *disrupted* flights pekee – “Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted? No” [S1].  
- Kutumia chombo hiki hutaulizwa ada; “Self re‑booking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it” [S1].  
- Mabegi yatapelekwa kiotomatiki kwenye ndege mpya – “If checked‑in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight? Yes” [S1].  
- Unaweza kufanya re‑booking mara moja kwa kila usumbufu wa flight – “You can self‑rebook once per every disruption” [S1].

Kumbuka, ingawa unaweza kutumia zana hii kwa usafiri ulio ghafla, **usafiri wa miles haufanyiki “online modification” kwa kawaida** – “Can one modify an award ticket online? No, Tickets purchased with miles cannot be modified online” [S2]. Hii inamaanisha chaguo la self‑rebooking inapatikana tu kwa hali ya usumbufu, si kwa mabadiliko ya hiari.

**Hatua za haraka:**  

1. Nenda https://www.kenya‑airways.com/en‑ke/ → *Manage Booking*.  
2. Ingiza booking reference au namba ya e‑ticket.  
3. Chagua ndege mbadala inayokufaa, thibitisha bila malipo.  

Ukikosa kujibu au chagua “DECLINE CHANGES”, itakupeleka kwenye Customer Excellence Centre kwa msaada zaidi.  

Kama unahitaji msaada wa ziada au unataka kubadilisha sehemu ya ziada (k.m., inbound flight baada ya kupoteza siku), itabidi upigie simu kituo cha mawasiliano au muwasiliane na wakala wako. [S1]

outcomes.question: Nimepata begi moja lakini la pili halijafika. Je, lazima nilipwe posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza?
outcomes.final_response:
Begi lako la pili bado halijafika, lakini kwani umepokea begi moja, kwa mujibu wa sera ya Kenya Airways, **huna haki ya kupata First Needs Allowance (FNA)**.  

- **Pasajeri aliyepewa angalau mojawapo ya mabegi yake** hawawezi kudai FNA [S1].  
- FNA hulipwa tu kama **mteja hakupokea kabisa mabegi yake** na mabegi hayo hayajakuja ndani ya masaa 24 baada ya kutuma taarifa ya ukosefu [S1].  

Kama bagi la pili litashindwa kufika ndani ya muda huo, unaweza kuomba FNA kwa kuzingatia masharti yafuatayo:  

1. **Ripoti ya ukosefu wa begi** lazima iandikwe ndani ya siku 7 baada ya kuwasili, kwa ofisi ya Kenya Airways iliyo karibu nawe au kupokea msaada kutoka kampuni yako ya bima [S1].  
2. **Ushahidi wa manunuzi** wa vitu muhimu (risiti) unahitajika [S1].  
3. Vitu vinavyolipwa ni **vyenye thamani ya juu** pekee, na viko chini ya viwango vya:  
   - USD 150 kwa madaraja ya **First Class na Premier World**  
   - USD 100 kwa **Economy**  
   - Watoto 2‑12 yapata 50 % ya viwango vya daraja husika, watoto chini ya 2 hawapati FNA [S1].  

Pia, **wakazi wa nchi ya asili** (resident) hawawezi kudai FNA isipokuwa wanathibitisha kuwa wamekuwa wakiishi katika nchi nyingine kwa zaidi ya miezi 6 [S1].

Kwa hivyo, kwa hali yako ya kuwa umepokea begi moja, FNA haitahitajika, na hatupaswi kulipwa. Ikiwa bagi la pili halijakuja baada ya masaa 24 na unakutana na vigezo vilivyo juu, fuata taratibu za ripoti ya maandishi na uwasilishe risiti za manunuzi ya mahitaji ya msingi.  

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi au unahitaji msaada wa kuwasilisha taarifa, tembelea ofisi ya Kenya Airways iliyo karibu nawe au wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja.

outcomes.question: Je, ninaweza kulipia tiketi kwa Equitel nchini Kenya na nitapokea tiketi kwa njia gani?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, unaweza kulipia tiketi kwa kutumia **Equitel** (malipo ya simu ya mkononi nchini Kenya). Baada ya kulipa, tiketi yako itatumiwa kwa barua pepe kama **e‑ticket**. Tiketi hii itakuwa ushahidi wa malipo uliofanya, na itapokea barua pepe moja tu baada ya malipo kukubaliwa [S2]. 

Aidha, malipo ya Equitel yanachukuliwa kama mojawapo ya njia zinazokubalika kwenye tovuti na programu ya simu ya Kenya Airways [S1].

outcomes.question: Je, mtoto huyo anastahiki posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza?

fixed_history.content: Ninasafiri na mtoto wangu wa miezi kumi. Tulifika bila mizigo yetu iliyopakiwa.
Unauliza kuhusu huduma gani inayohusiana na mizigo?

outcomes.final_response:
Hapana, mtoto wako wa miezi 10 **hahataki posho ya mahitaji ya kwanza**. Siku ya umri wa chini ya miaka 2, watoto hawastahiki “First Needs Allowance” [S1].  

Kama unahitaji kujua taratibu za kudai fidia ya mahitaji ya msingi kwa ajili ya wewe mwenyewe (ambayo inahitaji risiti, ada ya juu ya USD 100 kwa daraja la Economy, n.k.), tafadhali wasiliana na ofisi ya Kenya Airways ndani ya siku saba baada ya kufika [S1].

outcomes.question: Baby wangu ako 10 months na hana own seat. Cabin baggage allowance yake ni gani, including dimensions?
outcomes.final_response:
Bebe wako wa miezi 10 ambao hana kiti mwenyewe anaruhusiwa kuchukua **kifurushi kimoja cha kaboni**.  
- Uzito wa juu kabisa: **12 kg**.  
- Vipimo vya juu zaidi: **L 55 cm × W 25 cm × H 35 cm**.  

Hii ni sheria maalum kwa **infants < 2 years that do NOT occupy a seat** [ S1 ].  
Kifurushi hicho kinapaswa kuwa na lebo “approved KQ cabin luggage” ili kiwe kinakubalika [ S1 ].

outcomes.question: Nina ubao wa kuteleza kwenye mawimbi wenye urefu wa sentimita 150. Niombe kibali kabla ya safari? Kuna mipaka gani?
outcomes.final_response:
**Kibali cha ubao wa kuteleza (surfboard) wa 150 cm** - Kwa sababu urefu wa ubao wako ni 150 cm, unazidi 107 cm, **unahitaji ruhusa ya mapema** (advance clearance) kabla ya kusafiri. [S2] - Ruhusa hii itahifadhiwa kwenye PNR yako kama *“SPEQ SURF”* na *“XBAG”* ili wafanyakazi wa Kenya Airways wajue kuwa umekusudia kusafirisha kifaa hiki. [S2] **Mipaka ya usafirishaji** | Kipengele | Kiwango kinachokubaliwa | Hatua ikiwa kipenye mpaka | |-----------|------------------------|--------------------------| | Urefu | ≤ 107 cm – inakubaliwa bila kibali.
> 107 cm – inahitaji kibali cha mapema. | Omba kibali kutoka timu ya biashara ya Kenya Airways. | | Urefu (ukubwa zaidi) | ≤ 300 cm – inaweza kusafirishwa kama baggage ya kawaida ikiwa inatimiza masharti mengine. | > 300 cm – haitakubaliwa kama baggage; lazima iwasilishe kwa sehemu ya mizigo (cargo). | | Uzito | ≤ 32 kg – inakubaliwa kama baggage. | > 32 kg – haitakubaliwa kama baggage; itahitajika kusafirishwa kama cargo. | - **Ufungaji**: Bango la surf lazima lipakwe ndani ya kifuniko kinachofaa kilichotolewa na mgeni. [S2] - **Kazi ya kibali**: Ili kupata kibali, wasiliana na **timu ya biashara ya Kenya Airways** au tembelea ofisi yao ya mizigo kabla ya safari. outcomes.question: Nairobi to Mumbai na Business Class, checked bags ni ngapi na max weight ni gani?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa safari yako ya **Business Class** kutoka Nairobi ➝ Mumbai, unaruhusiwa kubeba **1 piece** ya checked baggage, na kila piece inaweza kufika **32 kg (70 lbs)** kwa uzito wa juu. [S1]  

Kumbuka, taarifa hii ni kwa safari zinazotumiwa na Kenya Airways pekee na inaweza kubadilika kulingana na aina ya ndege inayotumiwa siku ya safari. [S1]

outcomes.question: I'm travelling from Nairobi to New York. When does online check-in open and close?
outcomes.final_response: For a Kenya Airways flight from Nairobi to New York (a flight that involves the United States), online check‑in opens **24 hours before the scheduled departure time** and remains available **until 1 hour before take‑off**. [S1]

outcomes.question: Hiyo fee nalipa before travel ama airport?
outcomes.final_response:
Ushuru wa mtoto asiyekuwa na mtoto (Unaccompanied Minor Fee) unatozwa kwa huduma hii, isipokuwa safari za ndani (NBO, MBA, KIS) ambazo hutoa msamaha wa ada [S2]. Hata hivyo, maelezo haya hayaelezi wazi kama ada hulipwa kabla ya safari au katika uwanja wa ndege. Kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa taarifa, hatuwezi kuthibitisha muda sahihi wa malipo.  

Kama unahitaji kujua taratibu za malipo, tafadhali wasiliana moja kwa moja na kituo cha Kenya Airways au tembelea sehemu ya ushauri kwa wateja.  

Natumai haya yanakusaidia!

outcomes.question: Nikikabidhi mabegi matatu wakati wa kujisajili, nitapewa lebo moja au lebo kwa kila begi?
outcomes.final_response:
Samahani, taarifa zilizotolewa hazijumuishi sera kuhusu idadi ya lebo za mabegi unazopata wakati wa kukabidhi mabegi matatu. Kwa maelezo sahihi juu ya lebo kwa kila begi, tafadhali wasiliana moja kwa moja na Huduma kwa Wateja wa Kenya Airways au tembelea tovuti yetu.  

Ikiwa una swali lingine lolote kuhusu sera za tiketi, mabadiliko au ada, nitafurahi kusaidia.

outcomes.question: Nilianza journey halafu nikakuwa sick at a stopover. Can ticket validity be extended and what proof do I need?
outcomes.final_response: Ndiyo, tunaweza kuongeza muda wa usahihi wa tiketi yako kama umeshindwa kusafiri kwa sababu ya ugonjwa baada ya kuanza safari.  Hii itafanyika mpaka utakapopona au hadi safari yetu ya kwanza itakapoendelea baada ya siku ile, kulingana na nafasi inayopatikana kwenye daraja la huduma ulilililipa.  Unahitaji kuwasilisha **certificat ya matibabu** kama uthibitisho wa ugonjwa.  Kwa tiketi (au coupon ya kielektroniki) inayojumuisha **stopovers**, muda wa upanuzi hauwezi kuzidi miezi mitatu kutoka tarehe iliyotolewa kwenye cheti cha matibabu.  Vilevile, tutaweza kuongeza muda wa usahihi kwa washiriki wa familia yako wa karibu walio pamoja nawe.  [S1]

outcomes.question: I use prescribed injections. What does the baggage policy require for my medically necessary syringes?
outcomes.final_response:
Medically necessary needles and syringes are allowed in your baggage provided you have the prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the prescribing medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer. With that label, the syringes are exempt from the general prohibitions on sharp or hazardous items [S1].

For smooth handling, keep the syringes (and any accompanying medication) in your cabin baggage and travel with:

* the original prescription label, and
* a doctor’s letter confirming the need for the injections.

Kenya Airways also recommends carrying the prescription and doctor’s note in your hand baggage and informing a cabin‑crew member if you will need to administer an injection during the flight [S2].

outcomes.question: Tiketi yangu ni ya KQ lakini ndege inaendeshwa na shirika lingine. Masharti ya shirika gani yanahusu kupanda ndege na yapi yanahusu kurejeshewa pesa?
outcomes.final_response:
Tiketi yako imechukuliwa na Kenya Airways (KQ), lakini ndege inaendeshwa na shirika lingine kwa sababu ya **code‑share**. Kwa hivyo:

| Sehemu | Ni masharti ya shirika gani yanayotumika | Maelezo muhimu |
|--------|------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| **Kupanda ndege (boarding, huduma, ucheleweshaji, usimamizi wa mizigo, n.k.)** | Masharti ya **shirika linalotoa huduma** (operating carrier). | Kazi, taratibu za usalama, uamuzi wa kukubali au kukataa kupanda, na huduma ndani ya ndege zinadhibitiwa na masharti ya shirika hilo linalofanya safari, kama ilivyo katika **Article 2.3 – Code Shares** [S1]. |
| **Masuala ya kikatiba – tiketi, kurejeshewa pesa, madeni ya uwajibikaji** | Masharti ya **Kenya Airways**. | Sheria za kifedha, haki ya kurejeshewa fedha, na masuala mengine ya kikatiba yanadhibitiwa na masharti ya Kenya Airways, kama ilivyo katika **ARTICLE 10 – REFUNDS** [S1] na **INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS** [S1]. |

### Kurejeshewa Pesa  
- Kenya Airways itarejesha tiketi au sehemu isiyotumika kulingana na sheria za kodi ya tiketi (fare rules) [S1].  
- Rejesho linaweza kutolewa **kwa mpokeaji wa tiketi au kwa mfanyakazi aliye kulipa**, kulingana na masharti ya tiketi [S1].  
- Katika hali ya **kufutwa au usafiri usio wa hiari** (mfano, flight inayoghairiwa, kuchelewa kwa kiasi kikubwa, kukosa kuwasilisha muunganisho wa uunganisho), mteja anapewa chaguo tatu: (i) kupelekwa kwenye safari inayopatikana bila malipo, (ii) kuelekezwa tena kwa njia nyingine, au (iii) kurejeshewa pesa [S1] (sehemu 9.2.2.1‑9.2.2.3).  
- Kiasi, muda, na masharti maalum ya kurejeshewa yategemea **sheria za kodi ya tiketi**; hakuna malipo ya ziada ambayo Kenya Airways itachukua isipokuwa ikibeba masharti mengine ya tiketi [S1].

### Denied Boarding (Kukataliwa Kupanda)  
Kama Kenya Airways hawezi kukupa nafasi ya kupanda, utapewa **fidia ya denied boarding** kulingana na sheria husika na sera ya fidia ya Kenya Airways [S1] (sehemu 9.3). Hii inategemea ufuatiliaji wa muda wa check‑in na boarding.

**Kwa muhtasari:**  
- **Uendeshaji wa ndege (kupanda, huduma, usalama)** – masharti ya shirika linalotoa huduma.  
- **Urejeshaji wa pesa na masuala ya kikatiba** – masharti ya Kenya Airways, kulingana na sheria za tiketi na chaguo za remedial (rebooking, reroute, refund).  

Ikiwa una maswali zaidi kuhusu masharti maalum ya shirika linalotoa huduma au unahitaji maelezo ya kifedha ya tiketi yako, tafadhali tuma maelezo ya ziada.

outcomes.question: If I pay through PayPal, how will I receive my ticket?
outcomes.final_response: When you pay with PayPal on the Kenya‑Airways website, the payment is processed securely. Once PayPal confirms the payment, Kenya Airways issues an electronic ticket and sends it to the email address you provided during booking【S2】. In other words, you’ll receive your ticket by e‑mail as soon as the payment is received【S1】.

outcomes.question: What happens to the fee I already paid for the seat?

fixed_history.content: I bought a preferred Economy seat, then my Business upgrade was accepted on that same leg.
What would you like to know about the upgrade?

outcomes.final_response: If you bought a chargeable (preferred) Economy seat and then upgraded to Business Class on the same leg, the amount you paid for that Economy seat is refunded to the credit‑card you used for the purchase [S1]. The refund is processed in the original currency and, apart from any bank‑related charges, will usually appear in your account within about ten (10) working days [S1].

outcomes.question: Mtoto wangu atasafiri alone na itinerary ina overnight connection. Is that allowed under KQ minor service?
outcomes.final_response:
Haiwezekani — kwa usalama wa mtoto usio na msafiri, **overnight connections haziruhusiwi kwa unaccompanied minors**. Unapaswa kupanga safari ili iende kwenye muunganisho wa siku ile ile au kutumia ndege zisizo na mabadiliko ya muda mrefu. [S2]  

Pia kumbuka:  
- Huduma hii inapatikana kwa watoto **wale walio kati ya umri wa 5 – 14** (au 15‑17 kwa idhini ya mzazi). [S2]  
- Unaccompanied minors wanapokelewa **tu kwenye ndege za Kenya Airways**, na ada ya huduma hutolewa isipokuwa safari za ndani (NBO, MBA, KIS). [S2]  

Kwa hivyo, chagua mpango wa safari usiokuwa na usiku wa kusubiri au tembelea kituo cha huduma maalum cha unaccompanied minor ili kupanga upya ratiba. [S2]

outcomes.question: Je, ninaweza kuhifadhi nafasi mtandaoni kisha kulipa fedha taslimu? Nipeleke nini na kuna ada?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, unaweza kufanya uhifadhi wa nafasi kupitia tovuti ya Kenya Airways kisha kulipa kwa pesa taslimu. Baada ya kutengeneza uhifadhi mtandaoni, tembelea ofisi ya tiketi ya Kenya Airways na lipa kwa pesa taslimu.  

**Unachohitaji kuleta**  
- Uthibitisho wa uhifadhi (booking confirmation) au nambari ya uhifadhi (booking code) uliyopokea kwa barua pepe. [S2]  

**Ada**  
- Kulipa kwa pesa taslimu kawaida kunatozwa ada ya ziada. [S2]  

**Kumbuka**  
- Si ofisi zote za tiketi zinakubali malipo ya taslimu, kwa hivyo hakikisha ofisi unayokwenda ina huduma hii. [S2]

outcomes.question: Niko na bulky item ya 310 cm combined dimensions lakini iko 25 kg. Can I just show up at check-in or niombe approval mapema?
outcomes.final_response:
Una kipande cha baggage kikubwa cha **310 cm** (inazidi 300 cm) lakini uzito ni **25 kg**. Kwa kiasi hicho, **maendeleo ya kibali ya awali ni lazima** – “authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team” [S1]. Hivyo, **huna uhakika wa kupokelewa ikiwa utaenda tu kwenye check‑in bila ubora wa XBAG kwenye PNR yako** [S1].

**Nini cha kufanya:**

1. **Wasiliana na timu ya commercial** au ofisi ya Kenya Airways mapema ili kuomba “bulky XBAG transportation” clearance.  
2. Mara idhiari itakapopatikana, itatokea kwenye PNR yako kama “XBAG comment” [S1].  
3. Katika check‑in, mhudumu atakagua PNR ili kuthibitisha kuwa kibali kipo. [S1]  
4. Ikiwa kibali hakijapo, shirika linaweza kukusitisha au kuamua kukubali kulingana na uwezo wa ndege, lakini hii sio hitilafu ya kujitegemea [S1].

Kwa hiyo, **usijiunge na airport bila kupokea kibali cha awali**; pokea uthibitisho wa “bulky XBAG” mapema ili kuepuka kukataliwa au kuchelewa.

outcomes.question: Nikiprepare suitcase ya check-in, label inafaa kuwa na details gani ndani na nje?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama unajiandaa bag ya *checked‑in*, lazima uwe na **label** ambayo imewekewa taarifa zifuatazo **nje** na **ndani** ya mfuko:  

- Jina kamili la abiria (linalofanana na lililotajwa kwenye tiketi)  
- Anwani ya kimwili (physical address)  
- Nambari ya simu ya mawasiliano  
- Barua pepe (inapendekezwa, si lazima)  

Label hii inahitajika kuwekwa **pamoja** kwenye uso wa bag na ndani ya bag, ili iwe rahisi kutambua abiria bila shida. [S1]

outcomes.question: What is the global telephone number for Kenya Airways customer support, not the mobile or WhatsApp number?
outcomes.final_response: The global telephone number for Kenya Airways customer support (landline) is **+254 734 104 747**【S1】.

outcomes.question: My eight-year-old is eligible for first needs allowance after delayed bags on Economy. What is the child's maximum?
outcomes.final_response:
Your eight‑year‑old child can receive **USD 50** as the maximum First Needs Allowance.  

- The standard limit for Economy‑class passengers is USD 100 [S1].  
- Children aged 2‑12 receive 50 % of that limit [S1].  

Therefore, the child’s entitlement is 50 % × USD 100 = USD 50.

outcomes.question: I have a Business ticket from Nairobi to Kisumu. What checked baggage is included?
outcomes.final_response:
For a Business‑class ticket on a Nairobi → Kisumu flight the specific checked‑baggage allowance (weight or number of pieces) is not detailed in the policy information provided. The only baggage‑related points that are confirmed are the general handling requirements:

* Every checked piece must carry a name label with the passenger’s name, address and phone number (and an email is recommended) [S1].
* The airline’s Conditions of Carriage apply to all baggage [S1].

Because the exact Business‑class allowance for this domestic route isn’t stated in the available evidence, we can’t give a definitive weight or piece count. Please refer to the fare rules shown with your ticket or contact Kenya Airways Customer Service for the precise allowance for your itinerary.

outcomes.question: Baggage team wamesema missing bag haiwezi arrive within 24 hours. Do I have to wait until next day before FNA inaweza kulipwa?
outcomes.final_response:
Unapowasiliana na timu ya baggage na wamebaini kuwa begi lako halitaweza kurudi ndani ya masaa 24, **hakuna haja ya kusubiri siku ijayo ili upate First Needs Allowance (FNA)**. Kulingana na sera, **FNA inaweza kulipwa “on the spot” mara tu itakapothibitishwa kwamba begi halitaweza kufika ndani ya saa 24** [S1].

Ili upate malipo, hakikisha:

- Hakuna begi lolote lililokupata (ukipokea angalau moja, huwezi kutimiza haki ya FNA) [S1].
- Uleta risiti za vitu muhimu ulivonunua (receipt requirement) [S1].
- Malipo yanazuiliwa kwa kiwango cha **USD 150 kwa First Class/ Premier World** na **USD 100 kwa Economy**; watoto wa umri 2‑12 wanapata 50 % ya kiasi hicho, watoto chini ya 2 hawatupati [S1].

Pia, ukitaka kufanya claim, **ni lazima uwasiliane kwa maandishi ndani ya siku saba (7) baada ya kufika** [S1]. Hii ni pamoja na kutaja nambari ya faili uliopata wakati wa kuripoti bagi lililopotea. 

Kwa hivyo, endelea na timu ya baggage, wasilisha risiti, na chukua FNA mara tu itakapothibitishwa kuwa bagi halitaweza kurudi ndani ya saa 24.

outcomes.question: Niko Asante Silver na Economy ticket. Extra checked bag allowance yangu ni gani?
outcomes.final_response:
Asante Silver member ulipokuwa kwenye **Economy** unapata **piece moja zaidi** ya mizigo ya kuangushwa, yenye uzito wa hadi **23 kg** kwa kila bagi (kama inavyoelezwa kwa Asante Silver tier) [S1]. Hii ni ziada juu ya kiwango cha kawaida cha Economy (ambacho kinaweza kutofautiana kutegemea njia, lakini kiwango cha ziada ni kificho kilicho wazi). Kwa hivyo, unaweza kuingiza bagi la ziada la 23 kg bila malipo ya ziada.  

Kumbuka: uzito wa kila bagi hauna kupita 23 kg; kama bagi lako linazidi uzito huo, malipo ya ziada yatakuwa. [S1]

outcomes.question: Niko na baby wa one year, can I bid for a Business Class upgrade?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndio, unaweza kufanya **bid** ya upgrade kwenda Business Class kwa ajili yako na mtoto wako wa mwaka mmoja, mradi una tiketi ya Economy. Programu ya “Bid to Upgrade” inaruhusu yeyote aliye na tiketi ya Economy kutoa kiasi anachotaka kulipa kwa upgrade, na hii inajumuisha watoto walioko kwenye reservation hiyo [S2].

**Mambo muhimu unayopaswa kujua**

| Suala | Jibu | Chanzo |
|-------|------|--------|
| **Je, bid ni bure?** | Ndiyo, utoaji wa bid hufanywa bila malipo. Kadi yako ya mkopo itahitajika kwa uthibitisho tu; malipo yanachukuliwa tu ukipokea upgrade. | [S1] |
| **Kiasi cha chini/kubwa** | Mfumo una kiwango cha chini na cha juu cha bid. Haiwezi kupitisha kiwango cha juu wala kushuka chini ya kiwango cha chini. | [S1] |
| **Kunaweza kubadilisha bid** | Unaweza kubadilisha kiasi kabla ya kupokea barua pepe ya uthibitisho, kwa kutumia kiungo kilicho kwenye barua ya bid. | [S1] |
| **Kutoa bid kwa kila segment** | Unaweza kutoa bid tofauti kwa kila sehemu ya safari inayostahiki upgrade. | [S1] |
| **Barua pepe ya uthibitisho** | Ukabidhi bid, utapokea barua pepe yenye maelezo ya matokeo. Ikiwa bid yako imekubaliwa, barua pepe itakuambia ndani ya masaa 12 kabla ya kuondoka. | [S1] |
| **Msimbo wa “Strength Indicator”** | Huu ni mwongozo unaonyesha nguvu ya bid yako, lakini hauhuathiri uhakika wa kupata upgrade. | [S1] |
| **Vilele vya mtoto (infant)** | Mtoto anasafiri kwenye kifaa cha mlezi (lap) wa mzazi, na upgrade haibadilishi kiwango cha mizigo cha Economy. | — (hakuna kikwazo kwenye ushahidi) |

Kwa muhtasari, ikiwa umeshasajili tiketi ya Economy, unaweza kutuma bid ya upgrade kwa ajili yako na mtoto wako. Hakikisha tu unafuata viwango vya chini na vya juu vilivyowekwa na unaweza kubadilisha bid yako mpaka saa 13 kabla ya kuondoka. Ikiwa bid yako itapokelewa, utapokea barua pepe ya uthibitisho ndani ya masaa 12 kabla ya safari.

outcomes.question: Zabuni yangu ya daraja la biashara ikikubaliwa, je, KQ itanihakikishia kiti fulani ninachotaka?
outcomes.final_response:
KQ haina uhakikisho wa kupata kiti maalum ulichokitaka. Baada ya ofa yako ya kuboreshwa (upgrade) kukubaliwa, sehemu zilizobaki za Business Class zitatengwa kiotomatiki, na kiti chako kitawekwa kulingana na upatikanaji [S1]. Utapokea barua pepe ya uthibitisho wa upgrade kabla ya kuondoka, kisha unaweza kufanya check‑in mtandaoni kwa Business Class, lakini chaguo la kiti husita kutolewa [S1].  

Kwa kifupi, upatikanaji wa kiti unategemea nafasi zilizo tayari, siyo chaguo la kiti maalum.

outcomes.question: Baada ya kujipangia ndege nyingine kutokana na hitilafu ya ratiba, je, daraja langu la safari na kiwango cha mizigo vitabadilika?
outcomes.final_response:
Daraja la safari lako halitabadilika. Hata kama ubora wa tiketi yako ubadilishwa (kwa mfano upokelee ofa ya kupandishwa ngazi), masharti ya tiketi ya awali ya *Economy* yataendelea kutumika, ikijumuisha sera za ubatilishaji, ada za mabadiliko, na sheria za kupata maili za mteja wa mara kwa mara【S1】.  

Kiwango cha mizigo pia hukaa sawa kama kilichopangwa kwa tiketi yako ya *Economy* ya awali. Kiasi cha mizigo ya bure kinatolewa kwa kila sehemu ya safari kulingana na masharti ya sehemu husika, na hakutabadilika kutokana na mabadiliko ya ratiba【S1】.  

Kwa hivyo, baada ya kujipanga upya, daraja lako la safari na kiwango chako cha mizigo vitabaki vile vile kama yalivyokuwa awali.
