outcomes.question: Carry-on yangu imeharibika. KQ Conditions of Carriage inasema airline liable under what condition?
outcomes.final_response:
KQ itakubali kuwajibika kwa damage ya carry‑on (bagajui) **tu** ikiwa *unapoongea* kwa thamani ya juu kabla ya kusafiri na ulimalipa ada ya ziada [**S2**]. Bila deklarashi hiyo, kampuni haichukui dhima kwa vitu vya nyepesi, vitu vya thamani, vyenye unyogovu, au vilivyopakuliwa katika vifungashio vibovu [**S2**].

Kama bagajui yako imeharibika, lakini hukuwahi kutangaza thamani ya ziada, KQ haina jukumu la kulipa fidia. Inashauriwa kuweka vitu vya thamani, nyaraka muhimu na pesa *on‑person* au *in‑cabin baggage* [**S2**]. Kwa ushauri zaidi, pata bima ya usafiri ya kibinafsi. 

*Ufafanuzi*: “UNCHECKED BAGGAGE” inamaanisha bagajui yako ambayo si *checked baggage* [**S1**].

outcomes.question: Flight ya New York, online check-in inafunguka na kufungwa hours ngapi before departure?
outcomes.final_response: Online check‑in kwa safari yako kwenda New York (USA) itafunguka **24 saa kabla ya muda wa kutokea** wa ndege, na itabaki inapatikana hadi **saa 1 kabla ya kuruka**. [S1]

outcomes.question: Nitasafiri kwa daraja la uchumi kutoka Nairobi hadi Johannesburg. Ninaruhusiwa kubeba mizigo kiasi gani ndani ya ndege?
outcomes.final_response:
Katika daraja la **Uchumi** (Economy) kwa safari yako **Nairobi ↔ Johannesburg**:

**Mizigo ya kabini (hand luggage)**
- 1 kipande cha mizigo, ukubwa wa juu wa L 55 × W 25 × H 35 cm.  
- Pia unaweza kubeba kifaa cha ziada (kama begi ndogo, kamera, laptop, nk) – jumla ya uzito **haizidi 10 kg / 22 lb**.  
- Kifaa cha ziada kina ukubwa wa juu wa L 40 × W 15 × H 30 cm.  [S1]

**Mizigo ya kibiwi (checked‑in baggage)**
- 2 vipande, kila kipande kikiwa na uzito wa **max 23 kg / 50 lb**.  [S1]

**Kumbuka**: Vifunguo hivi ni kwa ndege zinazendeshwa moja kwa moja na Kenya Airways, na yanaweza kubadilika kulingana na aina ya ndege itakayotumika siku ya safari.  [S1]

outcomes.question: My scheduled flight was disrupted and I did not use the rebooking link. What will happen to my reservation?
outcomes.final_response:
If you didn’t use the self‑rebooking link, Kenya Airways’ system will automatically place you on the next available flight and send you an email with the new flight details. You’ll also receive your e‑ticket and boarding pass once the new flight is confirmed. [S1] 

You can still log in to Manage Booking on the Kenya Airways website to view the re‑booked itinerary or, if you prefer a different option, you may use the self‑rebooking tool at any time—there is no charge for doing so. [S1]

outcomes.question: Familia yangu inataka kuweka mizigo mingi kwenye begi moja kuliko kiwango chake. Je, tunaweza kufanya hivyo ikiwa uzito wa jumla haujazidi kiwango chetu?
outcomes.final_response: Hapana, familia hawezi kuweka mizigo mingi kwenye begi moja ikiwa itaivuka idadi ya vipande vilivyoruhusiwa, hata kama uzito wa jumla hauzidi kiwango cha bure. Kukusanya mizigo kunaruhusiwa kwa “pooling” ya **idadi** ya mizigo, si ya uzito wa kila kipande. Kwa mfano, ikiwa usawa wa bure ni 2 kipande cha 23 kg kila kimoja, huwezi kuleta kifurushi kimoja cha 26 kg na kingine cha 18 kg. Kipande kimoja hakivai uzito ulioruhusiwa kwa kipande kimoja, na ukivuka, malipo ya ziada yatatozwa [S1].

outcomes.question: Nikifika na kifurushi kisichofungwa vizuri, je, shirika linaweza kukataa kukipakia?
outcomes.final_response:
Kifurushi kisichofungwa vizuri kinachojulikana kama “unchecked baggage” inarejelewa katika **S1** kama “any of your Baggage other than Checked Baggage” [S1]. Suala la ikiwa Kenya Airways inaweza kukataa kukipakia haijatajwa katika sera zilizotolewa; masharti ya usafirishaji yanahusiana na uwanja wa ndege, hali ya charter, na ushirikiano wa code‑share, lakini hayajadili hali ya vifurushi visivyofungwa vizuri [S1].

Kwa hivyo, kwa kuzingatia ushahidi uliopo, hatuna taarifa maalum inayothibitisha au kukataa haki ya shirika katika hali hiyo. Inashauriwa uwasiliane moja kwa moja na kituo cha mawasiliano cha Kenya Airways ili upate maelezo ya kina na ushauri unaofaa.

outcomes.question: If I qualify for first needs allowance, award ticket inamaanisha silipwi ama cap ni gani?

fixed_history.content: Niliredeem miles for Economy Class na checked bags zangu hazijafika.
Ungependa kujua kuhusu which baggage service?

outcomes.final_response:
Kama una tiketi ya **award**, bado una haki ya kupokea First Needs Allowance (FNA) kulingana na daraja la tiketi yako — hii imewekwa wazi katika sera ya Kenya Airways [S1].

Kiasi cha juu (cap) kinategemea daraja:

- **First Class / Premier World** – kiwango cha juu ni **USD 150** [S1].
- **Economy Class** – kiwango cha juu ni **USD 100** [S1].

Kwa hivyo, ukipata award ticket ya First Class, ubora wa FNA una juu ya **USD 150**; si bure, bali ni kiwango cha kiasi ambacho unaweza kudai baada ya bag iliyokosekana. [S1]

outcomes.question: Niko over free baggage allowance. Where can I confirm excess baggage rates and will I have to pay?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza kuthibitisha viwango vya baggage ya ziada kwenye tiketi yako (e‑ticket), kwenye “trip summary”, au kwenye mfumo wa **Departure Control System (DCS)** wakati wa ku‑check‑in. Huko ndipo utaona kiasi cha bure kinachokupatikana na bei ya ziada ikiwa unazidi. [S1]

Kama mzigo wako unapita kiasi cha bure (kila kipande kinazidi uzito au idadi ya vipande vilivyoruhusiwa kwa familia, kundi au kumbi), ada ya baggage ya ziada itatozwa na itahitaji malipo. [S1]  

Kwa hiyo, ndiyo, itakubidi kulipa ada ya ziada kulingana na viwango vilivyopangwa katika mfumo wa DCS au kwenye tiketi yako. [S1]

outcomes.question: What weight and packing rules apply, and does that reduce my checked allowance?

fixed_history.content: I've booked an additional cabin seat for my fragile musical instrument.
What would you like to know about that arrangement?

outcomes.final_response:
The cabin‑baggage rules that apply to any item you want to carry in the cabin – including a fragile musical instrument – are:

* The bag (or case) must carry an **“approved KQ cabin luggage”** label [S1].
* It must stay within the normal cabin‑baggage size and weight limits that are shown on your ticket or in the Departure Control System [S1].
* If an airport authority or another airline imposes stricter limits, the item may have to be **checked in free of charge** provided it still meets the cabin‑baggage weight allowance; otherwise normal excess‑baggage charges apply [S1].

For checked baggage:

* Your **free checked‑baggage allowance** is the one displayed on your e‑ticket or in the check‑in system [S1].
* Anything that does not fit the cabin‑baggage criteria and is checked will be counted against that allowance. If the checked piece exceeds the free allowance, the excess will be charged [S1].

The evidence we have does **not contain specific weight or packing requirements for musical instruments**, nor does it state that adding a cabin seat for a fragile instrument automatically reduces your checked‑baggage allowance. In practice, the instrument would be treated like any other cabin item: it must meet the cabin‑baggage weight/size limits and carry the approved label. If it cannot, it will be checked and will use part of your normal checked‑baggage allowance.

If you need the exact weight limit for cabin‑baggage on your specific flight, or want to confirm whether the instrument will affect your checked‑baggage quota, please contact Kenya Airways customer service with your reservation details.

outcomes.question: Self-rebooking page inaonyesha flights within what time range kulingana na original flight?
outcomes.final_response: Self‑rebooking page inaonyesha chaguzi za ndege ambazo zinafikia **masaa < 24 ya kabla ya safari yako ya awali au hadi siku 7 baada ya muda wa awali** ya safari iliyopangwa. [S1]

outcomes.question: Bag yangu ikifika later, KQ wata-deliver kwa hotel ama kuna restrictions?
outcomes.final_response:
Bag yako itakapotumwa baadaye, polisi ya Kenya Airways kuhusu usafirishaji wa mizigo hadi hoteli haijatajwa katika taarifa tulizo nazo. Hivyo, hatuna maelezo ya kina kuhusu upatikanaji wa huduma hiyo au vizuizi vyovyote vinavyoweza kuwepo.  

Ili kupata jibu sahihi, tafadhali wasiliana moja kwa moja na **Customer Excellence Centre** au tembelea duka letu la huduma kwa wateja; wao wataweza kukupa taarifa maalum kuhusu utoaji wa mizigo kwa hoteli na masharti yanayohusiana nayo.  

Kama una maswali mengine yanayohusiana na usafiri, mabadiliko ya tiketi, au upandaji wa daraja, nitafurahi kukusaidia.

outcomes.question: Je, Kenya Airways italeta begi langu lililochelewa hotelini litakapofika, au kuna nchi ambazo huduma hiyo haipatikani?
outcomes.final_response:
Habari,  

Kulingana na sera zilizopo, **hakuna taarifa maalum kuhusu huduma ya kupeleka begi lililochelewa hoteli** unapoingia nchi husika, wala hatujui kama kuna nchi ambazo huduma hiyo haipatikani.  

Kwa hiyo, hatuwezi kuthibitisha kama Kenya Airways itakuletea begi hilo hoteli au ikufanyie usafirishaji wa moja kwa moja. Ili kupata jibu sahihi na maelezo ya kina, tunakushauri uwasiliane moja kwa moja na **kitengo cha huduma kwa wateja** kupitia nambari +254 711 024 747 au tembelea ukurasa wa **Customer Support** kwenye tovuti yetu.  

Tunaomba radhi kwa usumbufu uliojitokeza, na tunakutakia safari njema.

outcomes.question: Nahitaji nambari ya simu ya mkononi ya huduma kwa wateja ya Kenya Airways. Ni ipi?
outcomes.final_response: Nambari ya simu ya mkononi ya huduma kwa wateja ya Kenya Airways ni **+254 711 024 747** [S1][S2].

outcomes.question: Je, itatolewa upya au itathibitishwa tu?

fixed_history.content: Tiketi yangu ilitolewa na Air France, lakini sehemu iliyoathirika ya safari inaendeshwa na KQ. Nataka kutumia huduma ya kujipangia safari nyingine.
Unataka kufahamu nini kuhusu tiketi hiyo?

outcomes.final_response:
Tiketi yako itatolewa upya, siyo kuthibitishwa tu. Mfumo wa self‑rebooking wa Kenya Airways unapojaribu kuratibu upya safari za mashirika mengine (kama Air France) ambayo ina sehemu inayoendeshwa na KQ, tiketi husasishwa badala ya kutengenezwa tena. Hii inamaanisha tiketi itapapishwa upya baada ya ubadilishaji wa kiungo. [S1] 

Unaweza kutuma ombi la ubadilishaji kwa kujitengenezea kupitia “Manage Booking” kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways bila malipo. [S1]

outcomes.question: Nataka meal ya vegetarian vegan kwa flight yangu. General special meal request deadline ni gani na naomba kupitia wapi?
outcomes.final_response:
Mahitaji yako ya **Vegetarian Vegan Meal (VGML)** yapatikana – ni meal isiyo na bidhaa zozote za wanyama, kama mayai au maziwa [**S1**].

**Kipindi cha kuomba:**  
Usisite kuomba mapishi haya **saa 24 kabla ya safari yako** ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji [**S1**].

**Jinsi ya kuomba:**  
- **Online** kupitia kipengele cha *Book and Manage* kwenye tovuti ya Kenya Airways.  
- **Piga simu** kwa kituo chetu cha huduma 24‑saa kwa nambari +254 711 024 747.  
- Tembelea **ofisi yoyote ya mauzo** ya Kenya Airways.  
- Au **uliza wakala wako wa usafiri** (travel agency) [**S1**].

Kwa maelezo zaidi au msaada wa ziada, timu yetu iko tayari kukusaidia. Safiri salama!

outcomes.question: Can I book online then pay cash kwa office? Niende na nini na kuna fee?
outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza kufanya online booking kwamba bada ya kulipia kwa cash katika ofisi ya Kenya Airways. Baada ya kukamilisha booking kwenye kenya‑airways.com, utapokea booking confirmation au booking code kwenye barua pepe – hiyo ndiyo unayohitaji kupeleka ofisini. Kila ofisi ya tiketi itakuhitaji uthibitisho huyu ili kulipia na kupokea tiketi yako.  

Kuhusu ada, kuna fee adimu iliyowekwa kwa malipo kwa cash [**S1**]. Pia, si ofisi zote zinazokubali malipo kwa cash, hivyo ni bora kuhakiki kama ofisi iliyokaribia inakubali njia hii. 

Kwa muhtasari:  
1. Fanya online booking.  
2. Hifadhi booking confirmation/booking code.  
3. Nenda ofisini ya tiketi (hakikisha inakubali cash).  
4. Lipa kwa cash (utatozwa fee [**S1**]).  
5. Pokea tiketi kwamba imekutumwa kwa barua pepe.  

Kama una maswali zaidi, niambie.

outcomes.question: My itinerary contains different branded fares. Which refund rule applies and can I recover booking-change fees?
outcomes.final_response: If your reservation includes more than one Kenya Airways branded fare, the **most restrictive fare rule** governs the entire itinerary — the stricter of the fare conditions will be applied to all segments. Additionally, **any fees you paid for booking changes are non‑refundable**, so they cannot be recovered. [S1]

outcomes.question: KQ imefuta sehemu iliyobaki ya safari yangu baada ya kutumia sehemu ya tiketi. Kiasi cha kurejeshewa pesa kinahesabiwaje?
outcomes.final_response:
Kiasi cha kurejeshewa pesa kinategemea jinsi sehemu ya tiketi iliyotumika imekaguliwa.

* **Umefutwa sehemu ya tiketi baada ya kutumia sehemu nyingine** – Hii ni “refund isiyo ya hiari” (involuntary refund). Kiasi cha kurejeshewa kitakuwa *si chini* ya tofauti kati ya **bei uliyoilipa** na **bei inayotumika** kwa safari kati ya sehemu zilizotumika tu. [S1]  
  * Kwa mfano, ikiwa ulilipia USD 500 kwa tiketi nzima, na sehemu ulizotumia inahesabiwa kuwa USD 300, basi marejesho yatakuwa angalau USD 200 (USD 500 – USD 300).

* **Sheria za tiketi bado zinafaa** – Marejesho yatafanywa kulingana na masharti ya tiketi yako (kama kuna vikwazo vya kurejesha, ada za huduma, nk). [S1]

* **Marejesho yataelekezwa kwa aliye kulipa tiketi** – Ikiwa tiketi ililipwa na mtu asiye msafiri, marejesho yatasindikwa kwa huyo aliye kulipa au kwa agizo lake. [S1]

* **Njia ya kuomba marejesho** – Kwa tiketi zilizonunwa kwenye mtandao wa Kenya Airways, unaweza kuomba marejesho kupitia kipengele cha “Refund” katika “Modify My Booking”.  Marejesho yatawekwa kwenye njia ile ile ya malipo uliyotumia. [S2]

* **Muda wa usindikaji** – Kwa kadi za mkopo/debit, Kenya Airways hutoa marejesho ndani ya siku 21‑30 za biashara, isipokuwa muda wa usindikaji wa benki yako. [S2]

Kwa hivyo, kurejeshewa pesa kunahesabiwa kwa kutoa tofauti ya bei kati ya jumla uliyoilipa na bei ya sehemu ulizotumia, kisha kupunguzwa na ada zozote zinazoruhusiwa kulingana na masharti ya tiketi. [S1]

outcomes.question: If security takes a restricted item from me at the boarding gate, am I guaranteed to get it back?
outcomes.final_response: No. When a security officer (or local authority) removes a restricted item at the boarding gate, Kenya Airways does not guarantee that you will get the item back. The guidance states that such items “may not be returned to you” depending on local conditions [S2]. Moreover, the airline’s liability clause expressly excludes responsibility for articles that are not permitted in baggage, so there is no obligation to return or compensate for those items [S1].

outcomes.question: Ninarudi kutoka Jeddah na nataka kuleta maji matakatifu. Ninaruhusiwa kiasi gani na niyafunge vipi?
outcomes.final_response:
Una ruhusa ya kubeba chupa **moja ya maji matakatifu** ikiwa unasafiri kutoka Jeddah, **kwa kiasi cha juu cha 5 lita**. Chupa lazima **iwe imefungwa kwa kifuniko cha plastiki** ili kuzuia uvujaji, na haipaswi kupita uzito wa **23 kg** kwa kila kipande cha mizigo, pamoja na vipimo visivyo ziidi 158 cm (L+W+H) [S1].

Pia, kila mzigo ulioangushwa unapaswa kuwa na **lebo ya jina** (jina, anwani, nambari ya simu, barua pepe ikiwa inashauriwa) kwenye nje na ndani ya mzigo, na jina liwe linalolingana na lililotolewa kwenye tiketi [S1].

Kwa kifupi:
- Chupa moja, hadi 5 lita, imefungwa plastiki.  
- Hakikisha uzito wa mzigo (chupa pamoja na mengine) haizidi 23 kg na vipimo havizidi 158 cm.  
- Weka lebo ya jina kwenye mzigo.  

Hii ndiyo kiwango kinachoruhusiwa na masharti ya usafirishaji.

outcomes.question: Company yangu ililipia ticket na ticket ina refund restriction. Refund itatumwa kwangu ama kwa company?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama tiketi imekuwa na **refund restriction** na ililipwa na kampuni (person besides the passenger), refund itatengenezwa **kwa kampuni hiyo au kwa order yake**, si kwa mpanda tiketi mwenyewe. Hii inasababishwa na kanuni ya “If a Ticket has been paid for by a person other than the Passenger … and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.” [S1]

Kumbuka kwamba **refund** bado itafanywa **kwa mujibu wa masharti ya tiketi** (ticket rules) – ikiwa kuna ada za huduma au ada za kughairi, hazitolewa. [S1]

outcomes.question: Niko na checked luggage pia. Niende wapi nikifika airport?

fixed_history.content: Nimecheck in online na boarding pass iko ready.
Do you need help with the next step at the airport?

outcomes.final_response:
Unaweza kurudi **online check‑in drop‑off point** kwa mizigo yako ya checked luggage, kisha uende moja kwa moja kwa **gate ya uboarding**. Hii inakupatia nafasi ya kuepuka foleni ndefu ya usuli wa mizigo.  

Kumbuka pia kwamba kwa safari za kimataifa, balaza ya ukaguzi (check‑in) lazima imekamilika **saa 2.5 kabla** ya kuruka, na kaunta za check‑in hufunga **saa 1 kabla** ya ndege kuondoka. Kwa safari za ndani, ukaguzi unapaswa kukamilika **saa 1.5 kabla** ya kuondoka, na kaunta hufunga **dakika 30** kabla ya kuruka.  

Kwa hivyo, baada ya kutuma mizigo kwenye drop‑off point, fuata alama za **“Boarding”** hadi ukutane na mlango wako wa kuabiri. [S2]

outcomes.question: Please approve my upgrade bid manually right now, hata kama bado iko pending.
outcomes.final_response:
Habari! Tunaelewa unataka bid yako iidhinishwe “sasa” hata iikuwapo bado pending. Kwa mujibu wa sera yetu, **bidi ya upgradeni hutolewa mtandaoni hadi masaa 7–10 kabla ya kuondoka, na ubalo wa “accept” hutegemea ikiwa bid yako ndiyo ya juu**; hatuwezi kuidhinisha kwa mikono bila kupitia mfumo. [S1]

Hivyo hatuwezi kukamilisha au kubadilisha hali ya bid yako kwa moja. Inashauriwa uangalie status ya bid yako baadaye, na itachukuliwa kiotomatiki ikiwa itashinda. Kama kuna maswali zaidi au unahitaji usaidizi wa kiufundi, unaweza wasiliana na huduma ya wateja wa Kenya Airways.

Asante, na tunakutakia safari njema!

outcomes.question: My flight leaves Guangzhou at 18:00. What is the counter closing time under the KQ policy?
outcomes.final_response:
The check‑in counters at Guangzhou close **90 minutes before departure**.  
For a flight scheduled to leave at 18:00, the counters will shut at **16:30**. [S1]

outcomes.question: Safari yangu ya kwenda imebadilishwa lakini ya kurudi haijabadilika. Je, ninaweza kubadilisha safari ya kurudi bila malipo kupitia huduma ya kujibadilishia nafasi?
outcomes.final_response:
Hapana, kwa kutumia chombo cha “self‑rebooking” unaweza kurudisha tu safari iliyosababisha usumbufu (yaani, safari ya kwenda). Usipate gharama ya ziada kwa ajili ya safari ya kurudi, ila itabidi uwasiliane na wakala wako wa usafiri au kituo cha Huduma kwa Wateja. [S1]  

Ikiwa unataka kurudia safari ya kwenda, tembelea tovuti ya Kenya Airways, ingia kwenye “Manage Booking”, kisha ufuate kiungo cha “rebooking” ambacho kitakuonyesha chaguzi zinazopatikana. Hii ni bure kwa safari zilizo na usumbufu. [S1]  

Kwa mabadiliko ya safari ya kurudi, chombo hicho hakikuruhusu, hivyo itahitaji usaidizi wa wakala au kituo cha wateja. 

Je, ungependa maelezo zaidi ya jinsi ya kuwasiliana na kituo cha wateja?

outcomes.question: Nahitaji syringes za prescription meds. Baggage policy inasema nibebe nini kama proof?
outcomes.final_response: Medically necessary sindano na syringe hazipigwa marufuku, lakini lazima uwe na **prescription medication** iliyo na lebo iliyochapishwa kitaalamu. Lea hii inapaswa **kuonyesha jina la ofisi ya matibabu, duka la dawa, au mtengenezaji** wa dawa. Hivyo, lebo hii ndiyo ushahidi unaohitajika kuonyesha unapobeba sindano za dawa yako. [S1]

outcomes.question: Nina trained service dog na itinerary iko na connection. What are the booking, direct flight and number-of-dogs rules?
outcomes.final_response:
**Booking**  
- Unapaswa kufanya **advance reservation** angalau **48 saa kabla** ya kuondoka. Kuna maelezo ya mawasiliano ya timu ya matibabu (Doctors.KQ@kenya‑airways.com, simu +254 734 104 747, Whatsapp +254 705 474 747). [ S1 ]  
- Baada ya kutengeneza reservation, PNR itakuwa **“ESAN”** ili kuonyesha kuwa ni service dog. [ S2 ]  

**Direct‑flight requirement**  
- Service dogs wanaruhusiwa **tu kwenye ndege za KQ Direct (non‑stop)**; **hakuna transfers** za wanyama wa huduma. [ S1 ]  
- Hata kama ni flight irefu, dog haipaswi kuchukua kiti cha dharura, na haipaswi kuzuia mwendelezo wa aisle. [ S2 ]  

**Number of dogs**  
- Kila abiria anaweza kupeleka **maximum ya mbwa mmoja (1) pekee**. [ S1 ]  

**Additional basics (kwa ufahamu)**  
- Huduma ni **bure**, lakini lazima dog iendelewe na **harness**, iwe **haina sanduku**, na iwe imefungwa vizuri. [ S2 ]  
- Inahitajika **docu­mentation** (certi­ficate ya afya, barua ya daktari, cheti cha mafunzo) ambayo haipaswi kuwa **za zamani zaidi ya mwaka 1**. [ S1 ][ S2 ]  
- Dog itakaa **chini ya mgongo wa kiti cha abiria**, si kwenye viti vya dharura, na haipaswi kuzuia njia. [ S2 ]  

Kwa muhtasari, hakikisha unafanya reservation 48 saa mapema, chagua flight isiyo na stop‑over, na piga mbwa mmoja pekee kwa usalama na nyaraka sahihi.  Ikiwa una maswali zaidi, wasiliana na kituo cha huduma ya wateja.

outcomes.question: I'm booking from Tanzania with Tigo Pesa. Is that method listed and how is my ticket delivered?
outcomes.final_response: Yes, Tigo Pesa is listed as a mobile‑money payment option for bookings from Tanzania. Once you complete the payment with Tigo Pesa, Kenya Airways will send your e‑ticket to the email address you provided [S1].

outcomes.question: Nataka kusafiri na majivu ya ndugu yangu aliyefariki. Nahitaji chombo na nyaraka gani?
outcomes.final_response:
**Usafiri wa majivu ya ndugu yako**  

1. **Majivu ya kibinadamu (miili)**  
   - Majivu haya husafirishwa kama mizigo (cargo) [S1].  
   - Unapofanya **reservation**, lazima utumie **SSR code** `MAAS` ikifuatiwa na maneno “ESCORT HUMAN REMAINS” [S1]. Hii itaonyesha kwenye PSM na PIL/OBL iliwezeshe wafanyakazi wa ndege kuwapa msaada wa ziada na kurahisisha muunganiko wa mlinzi na maomboleza.  

2. **Mchanga (ashes) ya mtu aliyefariki**  
   - Mchanga unaweza kuleta kwenye kabini ya abiria (cabin) [S1].  
   - Lazima uwe katika **uruni uliofungwa** na **ulipaswa kujulikana chini ya kiti cha abiria au kwenye sehemu ya juu ya juu (overhead bin)**; hairuhusiwi kuwekwa kwenye kiti cha abiria au katika mtazamo wa abiria wengine [S1].  
   - Ili kuepuka maulizo ya maafisa wa usalama ya uwanja, **shahidi ya kufa** au **cheti cha krematari** inapaswa kubeba pamoja [S1].  
   - Kabla ya kusafiri, hakikisha ikiwa **destinasyon ya mwisho au njia ya kusafiri inahitaji “authorization for transportation certificate”**; ukihitaji, jiandae kuleta cheti hicho [S1].  
   - Katika **PNR** ya mgeni anayebeba mchanga, ongeza maelezo yafuatayo: `SR OTHS KQ- Accompanied by Ashes of deceased person` [S1].  

3. **Hatua za kuandaa safari**  
   - **Fanya reservation mapema** na tuma taarifa za `MAAS` au `SR OTHS …` kama ilivyoelezwa hapo juu.  
   - **Jumuisha nakala za nyaraka** (death certificate, cremation certificate, na, ikiwa inahitajika, cheti cha idhini ya usafiri) katika maagizo ya reservation au uwasilishe kwa ofisi ya Kenya Airways kabla ya safari.  
   - Hakikisha uruni wa mchanga unakidhi vigezo (fungwa, unaenda chini ya kiti au kwenye overhead bin).

outcomes.question: Je, ninaweza kubeba fimbo ya mchezo wa kriketi ndani ya ndege badala ya kuipakia kwenye sehemu ya mizigo?

Unaweza kubeba fimbo ya kriketi ndani ya kabini ikiwa inakidhi viwango vya ukubwa na uzito vilivyoainishwa kwa mizigo ya mkononi.  

- Kwa daraja la Biashara, unaruhusiwa kusafirishwa kwa **vipande 2** vya mizigo ya mkononi (kila kipande hadi L55 × W25 × H35 cm) pamoja na kifaa kimoja cha kibinafsi, jumla ya uzito wa **18 kg**.  
- Kwa daraja la Uchumi, unaruhusiwa kusafirishwa kwa **kipande 1** cha mizigo ya mkononi (hadi L55 × W25 × H35 cm) pamoja na kifaa kimoja cha kibinafsi, jumla ya uzito wa **12 kg**.  

[Vifaa vyote vya mizigo ya kabini lazima viwe na lebo ya “approved KQ cabin luggage”.] [S1]  

Kama fimbo yako haitokidhi ukubwa (au uzito) wa kipande kilichoruhusiwa, itahitajika kuipakishwa katika mizigo ya check‑in. Pia, “baadhi ya mamlaka ya viwanja vya ndege au mashirika ya ndege huenda yakuweka masharti ya ziada kuhusu kiasi, ukubwa, na uzito wa mizigo ya kabini; katika hali hiyo, kipande kitapitiwa bila malipo ikiwa kinakidhi viwango vya kibanda, vinginevyo itatozwa ada ya ziada.” [S1]  

Kwa hivyo, hakikisha fimbo yako inaendana na vigezo vilivyo juu; ikiwa haifanyi, itapaswa kuingizwa kwenye mizigo ya check‑in.  

Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi zaidi au unashaka kujua kama kuna vikwazo vya kipekee katika uwanja wa ndege unaotumia, tafadhali wasiliana na huduma ya wateja.

outcomes.question: Nisaidie kujua kama ninastahiki huduma hiyo.
outcomes.final_response:
**Ustahiki wa Huduma za Kimatibabu ya Kenya Airways**  

Ili kujua kama unastahiki huduma maalum (kama oksijeni, koncentrator ya oksijeni, kitanda cha uhamisho, au usaidizi wa matibabu), unahitaji kutimiza masharti yafuatayo:

| Huduma | Masharti ya ustahiki |
|--------|----------------------|
| **Kifaa chenye betri (kama koncentrator ya oksijeni)** | Betri lazima iwe na uwezo wa kutosha kwa 1.5× muda wa safari. Betri zote lazima zisafirishwe kulingana na sheria na kanuni husika. [S1] |
| **Kesi za ventiliyated** | Inahitajika kuwasilisha fomu ya **MEDIF** na kupata idhini ya kesi‑kwa‑kesi. Mteja lazima afuatane na daktari mwenye uzoefu katika usafirishaji wa matibabu hewani. [S1] |
| **Koncentrator ya oksijeni inayotumia betri** | Ikiwa unasema hautaitumia katika safari, betri lazima ibolewe na kupakuliwa kando, isipokuwa koncentrator ina sifa angalau mbili za kinga dhidi ya uendeshaji wa kimakusudi. |
| **Dawa ndani ya ndege** | Chukua dawa zako zote, barua ya daktari, na mapitisho ya mapelekezo. Kumbuka: hatuwezi kutunza dawa zilizobandwa ndani ya ndege. |
| **Oksijeni ya nje** | Kenya Airways hutoa oksijeni ya matibabu baada ya kupata **idhini ya matibabu** ya mgonjwa. Inahitajika msaidizi wa matibabu, isipokuwa sheria itakiweka tofauti. |
| **Kitanda cha uhamisho / Msaada wa uhamishaji** | Inapatikana baada ya **idhini ya matibabu** na **notisi ya angalau siku 48** kabla ya safari. Mteja atahitajika kuwasilisha **cheti cha matibabu** na msaidizi wa matibabu. |
| **Huduma za Msaidizi wa Matibabu** | Inahitaji **idhini ya matibabu** kulingana na sheria husika. [S2] |

**Hatua ya Kuanza**  
1. **Pata Idhini ya Matibabu** – Daktari wako atakupatia barua inayoelezea mahitaji yako ya kimatibabu.  
2. **Jaza fomu ya MEDIF** (kwa kesi za ventiliyated) na uitume kabla ya safari.  
3. **Taarifa ya Betri** – Hakikisha betri yako inatimiza viwango vya 1.5× muda wa ndege.  
4. **Wasiliana na Kenya Airways** ili kuratibu msaidizi wa matibabu, kitanda cha uhamisho, au oksijeni, na upe taarifa ya notisi (saa 48) pale inapohitajika.  

**Kumbuka:**  
- Hata kama unatimiza masharti haya, uthibitisho wa mwisho utatolewa na Kenya Airways baada ya kupitia nyaraka zako.  
- Ikiwa una maswali zaidi au unataka kujua huduma maalum (kama oksijeni vs. kitanda), tafadhali taja huduma unayotaka.

outcomes.question: KQ cancelled the rest of my journey after I had used part of the ticket. How is the involuntary refund calculated?
outcomes.final_response:
When Kenya Airways cancels the remaining legs of a ticket after you have already travelled on part of it, the refund is treated as an **involuntary refund**.

* **If none of the ticket has been used** – you receive a refund equal to the full fare you paid. [S1]

* **If part of the ticket has already been used** – the refund is **not less than** the difference between the amount you paid for the whole ticket and the fare that would apply for the journey you have already completed (i.e., the applicable fare for travel between the points you have already flown). [S1]

The refund is made subject to the ticket rules and is paid to the person who originally paid for the ticket (or that person’s order) if the ticket was purchased by someone other than the passenger. [S1]

outcomes.question: I'm expecting twins with no complications. What clearance and latest gestational limit does the KQ policy specify?
outcomes.final_response:
Kenya Airways requires a **medical clearance** for any passenger who is pregnant, even when the pregnancy is uncomplicated.

* **Medical Information Form (MEDIF)** – You must download, complete (in English), sign, stamp and date the form and submit it to doctors.kq@kenya‑airways.com or the 24‑hour Contact Centre at least **24 hours before travel**. The completed MEDIF is valid for **7 days** from the date it is issued [S1].

* **Notification** – If you will be travelling on a stretcher or need any special equipment, you must give **at least 48 hours’ prior notice** so that Kenya Airways can arrange the appropriate medical escort and equipment [S1].

* **Passenger Medical Clearance (PMC)** – Once your MEDIF is approved, Kenya Airways will issue a PMC form that you must carry with you for the entire journey [S1].

* **Changes in condition** – If your condition changes before the flight, you must inform doctors.kq@kenya‑airways.com immediately; a new MEDIF may be required [S1].

The policy documents provided do **not state a specific gestational age limit** for travelling while pregnant. Therefore, Kenya Airways does not appear to publish a maximum week‑of‑pregnancy cutoff in the evidence you’ve shared. You should contact Kenya Airways medical services directly (via the email or phone numbers above) to confirm whether your current gestational stage (twins, uncomplicated) meets their internal criteria. If you need assistance arranging a medical escort or equipment, the same contacts can help.

In summary, obtain a completed MEDIF at least 24 hours before travel (valid for 7 days) and provide a minimum of 48 hours’ notice for any special assistance. The exact gestational limit is not specified in the available policy [S1].

outcomes.question: Je, inatosha kuwatumia barua pepe?

fixed_history.content: Nimelipia tiketi ya safari ya KQ na sasa nataka kuomba kurejeshewa pesa.
Ni njia gani unafikiria kutumia kuwasilisha ombi?

outcomes.final_response:
Kumbuka kwamba baada ya kulipa, tiketi yako itatumwa kwako kwa barua pepe na itakuwa **uthibitisho wa malipo** ambao unakubalika kama risiti [S1].

Ili kuomba **urejeshaji wa pesa**, mchakato unafanyika kupitia **mchakato wa kawaida wa kurejesha kutoka ofisi inayotoa tiketi** [S1]. Suala la “je, inatosha kuwatumia barua pepe?” halijatajwa moja kwa moja katika sera; kwa hivyo hatuwezi kuthibitisha kwamba barua pepe pekee itatosha. Ni vyema kuwasiliana moja kwa moja na **ofisi ya kutolea tiketi** au kituo cha Huduma kwa Wateja ili kupata maelekezo sahihi ya kuwasilisha ombi lako.

Ikiwa unahitaji ushahidi wa malipo, unaweza kutumia tiketi iliyotumwa kwako barua pepe kama risiti [S1]. 

**Hatua zinazopendekezwa**  
1. Wasiliana na ofisi inayotoa tiketi (au kituo cha huduma kwa wateja) kwa njia iliyotajwa kwenye tiketi yako.  
2. Tuma maelezo ya ombi la kurejesha pesa pamoja na **uthibitisho wa tiketi** (barua pepe ya tiketi).  

Kama unahitaji msaada zaidi, tafadhali piga simu au tembelea kituo cha huduma kwa wateja cha Kenya Airways.

outcomes.question: Niliweka jewellery kwa checked suitcase na imepotea. Policy inaruhusu kuweka valuables huko, na KQ accepts liability?
outcomes.final_response:
Ninaelewa wasiwasi wako – ulipoweka jewellery kwenye checked suitcase, KQ haichukui jukumu la kupoteza kitu hicho.  

- Kwa mujibu wa **Conditions of Carriage**, Kenya Airways *hakubali jukumu* kwa upotevu wa jewellery, pesa, vifaa vya thamani, au nyaraka muhimu vilivyowekwa katika bagaji iliyo checked [S1].  
- Vilevile, **Article 8.3.4** inakataza kabisa kujumuisha fedha, jewellery, vifaa vya thamani, n.k., katika bagaji iliyo checked, na inasema ushawishi wowote juu ya makosa ya upotevu wa vitu hivi [S2].  

Kwa hivyo, politika haikubali kuweka valuables kama jewellery kwenye checked bag, na hatuiwe na wajibu wa kulipa fidia isipokuwa umekuja na “special declaration of interest” na umelipa ada husika, ambayo ni hali adimu sana na inahitaji usajili wa mapema [S2].  

**Ushauri**  
1. **Fanya claim** kwa Kenya Airways kupitia kitengo cha “Baggage Claim” – utapewa fomu na maelekezo, lakini fidia itategemea viwango vya makubaliano (Warsaw au Montreal Convention) na haitajumuisha thamani ya jewellery bila mapema ya “special declaration”.  
2. **Wasiliana na bima** yako ya kusafiri (au Kenya Airways Insurance) ili kupokea fidia ya ziada, kwani kampuni inashauri watumiaji wapate “adequate travel insurance” kabla ya safari [S1].  

Kwa muhtasari, KQ **hairuhusu** kuweka jewellery kwenye checked baggage na **haitoi** fidia kwa upotevu wa vitu hivyo, isipokuwa ulijumuisha mapendeleo maalum na kulipa ada husika. Tafadhali hakikisha vitu vya thamani vimebeba kwenye cabin baggage au mwili wako, na zingatia bima ya kusafiri kwa usalama wa ziada.

outcomes.question: My ticket is with KQ but another airline operates the flight. Whose rules govern boarding and whose govern refunds?
outcomes.final_response:
When a Kenya Airways ticket is sold for a flight that is actually operated by another airline, two sets of rules apply:

* **Boarding and all other operational matters** (e.g., check‑in, boarding procedures, in‑flight service, baggage handling) are governed by the **Conditions of Carriage of the operating carrier**【S1】.  
* **Contractual matters** such as the ticketing agreement and any refunds are governed by **Kenya Airways’ own Conditions of Carriage**【S1】.  

So, you follow the operating airline’s rules for getting on the plane, but any refund entitlement is determined by Kenya Airways’ refund policy.

outcomes.question: Natumia dawa za sindano nilizoandikiwa. Sera ya mizigo inahitaji nini ili nibebe sindano zangu za matibabu?

**Dawa za sindano (medicines)**  

- Kenya Airways haina vizuizi vya jumla kwa ajili ya kubeba dawa, isipokuwa dawa hiyo itakapoangukia kwenye kategoria ya *Dangerous Goods* kama vile kioevu kinachoweza kuchoma, vitu vya sumu, virusi, nyuklia, au gesi. [S1]

  3. Kuwa na nyaraka za kiafya (health documents) zinazohitajika kwa safari yako. [S1]  

- Dawa haziruhusiwi kuwekwa kwenye mizigo ya kulipwa (checked baggage) ikiwa ina uwezekano wa kusambaa au kuleta madhara kwa mizigo mingine.  

- Hakuna hitaji la ubora maalum wa ufungaji wa mizigo, isipokuwa dawa hizo ziwe sehemu ya **dangerous goods**; basi usibebe dawa zinazoweza kuchomwa, sumu au gesi bila idhini maalum.  

Kwa muhtasari, unaweza kubeba sindano zako za matibabu kwenye mzigo wa kaburi, ukihakikisha zimefungwa usafi, una barua ya daktari, na hawapo katika kategoria ya *Dangerous Goods*. [S1]

outcomes.question: Ninatarajia mapacha bila matatizo ya ujauzito. Sera ya KQ inahitaji kibali gani na inaweka kikomo gani cha wiki za ujauzito?
outcomes.final_response:
Sera ya Kenya Airways kuhusu ujauzito inahitaji **kibali cha matibabu (clearance certificate) kutoka daktari wa Kenya Airways** baada ya wiki 28 za ujauzito, bila kujali ikiwa ujauzito ni mmoja au mara nyingi [S1].

**Kikomo cha wiki za ujauzito kwa safari:**

| Aina ya ujauzito | Kikomo cha wiki za kusafiri (safari ya kuondoka) | Kikomo cha wiki kwa safari ya kurudi (return) |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Ujauzito wa pekee (usio na matatizo) | Hapana ruhusa baada ya kufika wiki 36 [ S1 ] | Safari za kurudi lazima ziwe ndani ya wiki 36 [ S1 ] |
| Ujauzito wa mapacha (multiple) | Hapana ruhusa baada ya kufika wiki 32 [ S1 ] | Safari za kurudi lazima ziwe ndani ya wiki 32 [ S1 ] |
| Ujauzito wenye matatizo | Kibali cha matibabu kinahitajika kwa kila hatua [S1] | Hakuna safari inaruhusiwa baada ya kufika wiki 32 kwa mapacha na 36 kwa pekee, kulingana na kiwango cha ujauzito [S1] |

Kwa muhtasari, ukihitaji kibali cha matibabu baada ya wiki 28 na lazima usafiri kabla ya kufika wiki 36 kwa ujauzito wa pekee au wiki 32 kwa ujauzito wa mapacha. Safari ya kurudi inapaswa kufanyika ndani ya viwango hivyo vya wiki. [S1]

outcomes.question: I'm travelling with my one-year-old. Can I make a bid for Business Class?
outcomes.final_response:
Yes – you can place a bid to upgrade from Economy to Business Class even when you are travelling on a round‑trip itinerary. All eligible flight legs in your booking will be shown, and you may submit a separate offer for each segment you wish to upgrade [S1].

**How the bidding works**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Cost of the offer** | Making an offer is free; you are only charged if the upgrade is accepted [S1]. |
| **Bid amount** | The system sets a minimum and maximum amount; offers outside that range are rejected. You choose any amount within those limits [S1]. |
| **Different amounts per segment** | You can submit different bids for each eligible segment of your journey [S1]. |
| **Changing the bid** | Before you receive the confirmation email you can raise or lower your offer using the link in that email [S1]. |
| **Taxes/fees** | No additional taxes or charges are added to the amount you bid [S1]. |
| **Cancellation of the offer** | You may cancel or modify your offer up to 13 hours before departure [S1]. |
| **If the upgrade is accepted** | The amount you offered is debited; it is not refundable if you later cancel the trip [S1]. |
| **If Kenya Airways cancels the flight** | The upgrade remains valid if you are re‑booked on another Kenya Airways flight at the same amount; otherwise the bid amount is refunded [S1]. |

**What about your one‑year‑old?**  
The evidence provided does not specify whether an infant (under‑2 years) can be included in the Business‑Class upgrade bid. For that detail you’ll need to contact Kenya Airways’ customer service or the contact centre to confirm the infant‑eligibility rules. 

If you decide to bid, just log in to the “Upgrade to Business Class” page, enter your booking details, and follow the on‑screen steps to place your offer [S2].

outcomes.question: Passenger anahitaji stretcher kwa flight. Ni-notify KQ how early, na what clearance or escort conditions apply?
outcomes.final_response:
Unahitaji huduma ya **stretcher**? Hapa kuna hatua muhimu na muda wa kuarifu:

1. **Muda wa kuarifu** – lazima uwasiliane na Kenya Airways angalau **48 saa** kabla ya safari yako ili kupata clearance ya stroller. [S1]

2. **Medical clearance** – 
   - Jaza **MEDIF (Medical Information Form for Fitness to Fly)** na uwasilishe kwa **doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com** au nambari za 24‑hour Contact Centre:  
     - Tel: **+254 734 104 747**  
     - Mobile: **+254 711 024 747**  
     - WhatsApp: **+254 705 474 747**.  
   - MEDIF lazima ijazwe **kiingereza**, iweke sahihi, stamp, tarehe, na itakuwa halali kwa **siku 7** baada ya kutolewa. [S1]  
   - Utahitaji **certificat ya matibabu** na/au **medical escort**. [S1]

3. **Medical escort** – Kwa safari inayohusisha stretcher, unahitaji **medical escort** (huduma hii inatozwa kwa ada).  
   - Escort hii inahitajika ili kuhakikisha usalama na huduma sahihi wakati wa safari. [S1]  
   - Unaweza kuomba huduma hii kupitia **KQ Medical** kwa ada ya ziada. [S1]

4. **Vilelezo vya ziada** – 
   - Endapo unahitaji vifaa vya matibabu au huduma za ziada, piga simu au tumia WhatsApp kwa maelezo kamili.  
   - Hakikisha una **medical certificate** na **MEDIF** tayari ili kuepuka ucheleweshaji. [S1]

Kwa muhtasari, **arifu Kenya Airways mapema (48 saa kabla), wasilisha MEDIF iliyojazwa kamili, weka cheti cha matibabu, na panga medical escort** ili kuhakikisha safari yako ya stretcher inaenda bila matatizo. 

Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi zaidi, tembelea **doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com** au piga simu/WhatsApp nambari zilizo juu. Safe travels!

outcomes.question: Ninasafiri kwenda Marekani. Je, ninaweza kubeba njiti ya kuwashia moto mfukoni au kwenye begi?
outcomes.final_response: Hapana, haziwezi kubebwa kwenye mwili wako, katika mizigo ya mkononi (hand baggage) au kwenye mizigo iliyokaguliwa (checked baggage). Lighters (zikiwemo zile za butane, za umeme, nk.) zimezuiliwa kulengwa na Sheria ya Usalama ya Usafiri (TSA) kwa safari zote zinazohusisha Marekani. [S1]

outcomes.question: Can I get a refund for part of it?
outcomes.final_response:
Yes – a partial refund can be possible, but it depends on why you are requesting it and how much of the ticket has already been used.

**If the refund is because the airline cancelled or otherwise failed to operate the flight (involuntary refund)**  
- When no part of the ticket has been used you are entitled to the full fare paid.  
- When any portion of the ticket has been used, the refund must be **at least** the difference between the fare you paid and the fare that would apply for the travel you actually completed — that is, the unused part of the ticket 【S1】.  

**If you are cancelling the ticket yourself (voluntary refund)**  
- If you have not used any part of the ticket, you can receive the fare paid **minus any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees**.  
- If you have used part of the ticket, the refund will be the difference between the fare you paid and the applicable fare for the segments you have already flown, again **minus any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees** 【S1】.  

**Other points to keep in mind**  

- Refunds are made only in accordance with the ticket rules and may be refused after the ticket’s validity expires 【S1】.  
- If the ticket was paid for by someone other than the passenger, the refund is made to that payer or their order 【S1】.  
- Taxes, fees and charges that are refundable under the ticket rules can also be returned, even for non‑refundable tickets 【S2】.  

**How to apply**  

- For tickets purchased on kenya‑airways.com, you can submit a refund request through the online refund widget 【S2】.  
- If the flight was delayed more than 8 hours, you can also use the same form, but note that submitting it will cancel the entire booking 【S2】.  

So, if you have only used part of your journey and the ticket’s fare rules allow a voluntary or involuntary refund, you should be eligible for a partial refund of the unused portion (after any applicable charges). Check the specific fare conditions on your ticket and submit the request via the online refund page. If you need further assistance, you may contact Kenya Airways customer service with your booking details.

outcomes.question: Nilinunua tiketi inayopita katika miji kadhaa. Je, ninaweza kubadilisha safari hiyo mtandaoni?
outcomes.final_response: Samahani, bila ya kutaka kitu kingine, tiketi za “multicity” haziwezi kubadilishwa kupitia mfumo wa mtandaoni. Ili kubadilisha safari yako, tafadhali wasiliana na kituo cha Mawasiliano cha Kenya Airways. [S1]

outcomes.question: How long does the carriage contract give me to bring a legal action for damages after travel?
outcomes.final_response:
The carriage contract sets a **two‑year limitation** for bringing any legal action for damages. An action must be filed within two years of **the date you arrived at your destination, the scheduled arrival date, or the date the carriage stopped**, whichever is applicable [S1].  

(For a claim, you must first give written notice of damage within 7 days of receiving the baggage, but the statutory limitation for a lawsuit remains two years.)

outcomes.question: My trained service dog will be with me on a nine-hour flight. What additional sanitation-related condition applies?
outcomes.final_response: For a flight that lasts 8 hours or longer, Kenya Airways requires you to provide documentation confirming that your service dog will not need to relieve itself during the journey, or that you are carrying the necessary items (e.g., nappies, medication) to prevent any health or sanitation issue on board. If you cannot meet this requirement, the dog cannot be accepted on the flight [S1].

outcomes.question: How far in advance should I request a kosher meal, and is it offered on every flight?
outcomes.final_response:
You should place a kosher‑meal request **at least 48 hours before your scheduled departure** — this is the specific lead time for the KSML code [S1].  

Kosher meals are **not guaranteed on every Kenya Airways flight**; availability depends on the route and aircraft, so some flights may not offer this option [S1].

outcomes.question: Mimi ni mwanachama wa Asante Silver ninayesafiri kwa daraja la uchumi. Ninaruhusiwa mizigo gani ya ziada?
outcomes.final_response:
Kama mwanachama wa **Asante Silver** unasafiri **daraja la uchumi**, unastahiki **kipande kimoja cha ziada** cha mizigo ya kuingia kwenye ndege. Kipande hicho kina kiwango cha **kilograms 23 kg** — sawa na kiwango cha mizigo ya kiuchumi (economy) kwa abiria wa kawaida.  

* **Mizigo ya kawaida (economy)**: 2 safi (23 kg kila moja)  
* **Mizigo ya ziada kwa Asante Silver**: +1 safi (23 kg)  

Kama utununuzi kiti cha ziada (kwa ajili ya faraja au kuhifadhi mizigo ndani ya kabini), unaweza kupata **mizigo ya bure ya ziada sawa na kiwango cha kifaa hicho**, lakini hilo ni punguzo la hiari na linahitaji ununuzi na idhini ya Idara ya Mapato. [S1]

outcomes.question: Naomba nambari binafsi ya simu ya rubani atakayeniendesha kesho.
outcomes.final_response: Samahani, lakini siwezi kukupa nambari ya simu ya mtu binafsi. Ikiwa unahitaji msaada au maelezo mengine, tafadhali nijulishe, nitafurahi kukusaidia.

outcomes.question: Nimepoteza baggage tag na receipt. Naweza collect suitcase yangu bado?
outcomes.final_response:
Habari, kwa kawaida baggage tag ni lazima uwe nayo ili kukusanya mzigo wako kwenye ukumbi wa maleta, lakini katika taarifa tulizonazo hakuna maelezo maalum kuhusu upotevu wa tag au receipt na jinsi ya kuendelea na uhoji wa mzigo. Hivyo, hatuwezi kuthibitisha kama unaweza kuchukua suitcase yako bila tag hiyo kwa kutumia masharti ya Kenya Airways.

Kwa sababu hii, tunakushauri uwasiliane moja kwa moja na **Customer Excellence Centre** au **Global Contact Center** ya Kenya Airways ili kupata ushauri maalum na miongozo ya hatua inayofuata. Wao wataweza kuthibitisha hali yako na kukusaidia kurejesha mizigo yako bila usumbufu.

outcomes.question: Nilikata tiketi kwa kutumia maili za zawadi na KQ ikafuta safari yangu. Je, huduma ya kujipangia safari nyingine baada ya hitilafu inatumika kwa tiketi hizo?
outcomes.final_response:
Ndiyo, huduma ya **kujipangia (self‑rebooking)** inatumika kwa tiketi zilizonunuliwa kwa **maili za zawadi**.  

- Zana ya kujipangia ina uwezo wa **ku-rebook tiketi za award** bila malipo ya ziada [S1].  
- Inapatikana tu kwa safari zilizokuwa **zimeghairiwa** (kama ulipokea barua ya usafiri uliofutwa/ulibadilishwa) [S1]; kwa safari ambazo hazijaghairi, haitawezwi kutumika [S1].  
- Usichukue chaguo la “Decline Changes”; badala yake tembea **Kenya Airways → Manage Booking** na ubofye kiungo cha “Click here” ili kuona chaguzi za safari mpya [S1].  
- Hutaulizwa ada ya kujipangia; zana hii imeundwa mahsusi kwa usafiri uliogongwa, hivyo **hautachukuliwa malipo** [S1].  
- Ikiwa hutajitahidi kujipangia, mfumo **utakupanga otomatiki kwenye ndege inayopatikana** na kutuma barua pepe yenye maelezo mapya [S1].

Kwa hivyo, ukichukulia barua ya usafiri uliofutwa, unaweza kujipangia kwa tiketi ya maili bila malipo, kwa kufuata hatua zilizo kwenye tovuti.

outcomes.question: The website priced my ticket in pounds but my card is in shillings. Can I choose shillings at checkout, and might my bank charge extra?
outcomes.final_response:
You cannot change the currency at checkout – the price you see (in British pounds) is the currency you must pay with. Kenya Airways only accepts payment in the currency that is displayed for your booking location and does not allow a different currency to be selected [S1].

If you pay with a card that is denominated in Kenyan shillings, your bank will convert the amount from pounds to shillings. The bank may apply its own exchange rate and could add extra fees, so you should check with your financial institution for any additional charges [S1].

outcomes.question: Je, mbwa wangu wa huduma aliyefunzwa anahitaji kizimba ndani ya ndege, na anaweza kukaa kwenye kiti karibu nami?
outcomes.final_response:
Mbwa wako wa huduma **hauhitaji kizima** ndani ya ndege; unaweza kupeleka akiwa amevaa kifaa cha usalama (harness) bila sanduku au kifungoni [**S2**].

Hata hivyo, **hauwezi kushika kiti** au kukaa kando yako katika kiti. Sheria inasema kwamba mbwa wa huduma **huwapaswa kutosimama kwenye kiti** na hawatakiwa kuchukua nafasi ya kiti chochote [**S2**].

Kama ni mbwa wa huduma aliyetunzwa rasmi, atahitaji:
- Cheti cha uhalali kinachoelezea kazi yake ya kusaidia.
- Hati kutoka kwa mtaalamu wa afya iliyotolewa ndani ya mwaka mmoja.
- Kuwa amevaa kifaa cha usalama na kutonyesha tabia iliyofaa; mbwa wa huduma anayekuwa na tabia ya kusumbua hataruhusiwi.

Kumbuka: mbwa wa huduma wanapokelewa bure, lakini **mbwa wa hisia (emotional support dogs) hawajiruhusiwa tena** kama wanyama wa huduma [**S2**].

outcomes.question: Ticket nilibuy kwa KQ website na return date ilishapita. Nitumie refund widget ama refund form? Will it cancel the whole booking?
outcomes.final_response:
Kwa tiketi ulioinunua kupitia **kenya‑airways.com** na tarehe ya kurudi imepita, unapaswa kutumia **Refund Form** – hii ni njia inayofaa kwa safari ambazo zimekwisha (inbound travel imepita).  

- Form hii inahitajika “when your inbound travel is in the past or cancelled” [S1].  
- Baada ya kuwasilisha fomu, **booking yote itafutwa kabisa**; hali hiyo inasababisha usitisha wa sekta zote za safari yako [S1].  

Kama ungechukua hatua hii, refund itarejeshwa kwa njia iliyo tumika kulipia tiketi (kadi ya mkopo/debit, M‑Pesa, n.k.) na itachukua siku 21‑30 za biashara kwa usindikaji [S1].  

Kwa kifupi: **tuma Refund Form**, si widget, na fomu itasababisha usitisha wa booking yote.  Hii ndiyo njia sahihi kwa hali yako.
